+    @GameTest(template="empty") public static void slabPlacementAndBounds(GameTestHelper helper) {
+        var player = helper.makeMockPlayer(GameType.SURVIVAL);
+        var pos = helper.absolutePos(CENTER);
+        helper.getLevel().setBlockAndUpdate(pos, Blocks.STONE.defaultBlockState());
+        for (var item : new net.minecraft.world.item.Item[]{PostedSignage.BRICK_VERTICAL_SLAB.get(), PostedSignage.SMOOTH_QUARTZ_VERTICAL_SLAB.get()}) {
+            player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, new ItemStack(item));
+            var block = ((net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem)item).getBlock();
+            for (Direction face : Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL) {
+                var placement = new BlockPlaceContext(context(player, pos, face));
+                var state = block.getStateForPlacement(placement);
+                helper.assertTrue(state.getValue(VerticalSlabBlock.FACING) == face.getOpposite(), "Slab hugs clicked face");
+                var shape = state.getShape(helper.getLevel(), placement.getClickedPos());
+                var bounds = shape.bounds();
+                helper.assertTrue(Math.abs(bounds.getXsize()*bounds.getYsize()*bounds.getZsize()-0.5) < 0.0001, "Slab occupies half a block");
+                helper.assertTrue(bounds.getYsize() == 1, "Vertical slabs are full height");
+                helper.assertTrue(state.rotate(Rotation.CLOCKWISE_90).getValue(VerticalSlabBlock.FACING) == face.getOpposite().getClockWise(), "Rotation follows collision geometry");
+            }
+        }
+        helper.succeed();
+    }

+    @GameTest(template="empty") public static void sampleApplyRepaintAndPersistence(GameTestHelper helper) {
+        var level = helper.getLevel();
+        var pos = helper.absolutePos(CENTER);
+        level.setBlockAndUpdate(pos, Blocks.BRICKS.defaultBlockState());
+        var player = helper.makeMockPlayer(GameType.SURVIVAL);
+        var tool = PostedSignage.TEXTURE_APPLICATOR.get();
+        player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND,new ItemStack(tool));
+        player.setShiftKeyDown(true);
+        helper.assertTrue(tool.useOn(context(player,pos,Direction.UP)).consumesAction(), "Sampling succeeds");
+        helper.assertTrue(player.getMainHandItem().has(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA), "Selection stored on tool");
+        // Copying a stack preserves selection, as does item component serialization.
+        player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND,player.getMainHandItem().copy());
+        player.setShiftKeyDown(false);
+        level.setBlockAndUpdate(pos,Blocks.STONE.defaultBlockState());
+        helper.assertTrue(tool.useOn(context(player,pos,Direction.NORTH)).consumesAction(), "Applying succeeds");
+        var coverPos = pos.north();
+        var cover = (TextureCoverBlockEntity) level.getBlockEntity(coverPos);
+        helper.assertTrue(cover != null && cover.sample().is(Blocks.BRICKS) && cover.sampleFace() == Direction.UP, "Correct selected material and face applied");
+        helper.assertTrue(level.getBlockState(pos).is(Blocks.STONE), "Original block preserved");
+        var restored = new TextureCoverBlockEntity(coverPos,cover.getBlockState());
+        restored.loadWithComponents(cover.saveWithFullMetadata(level.registryAccess()),level.registryAccess());
+        helper.assertTrue(restored.sample().equals(cover.sample()) && restored.sampleFace() == Direction.UP, "Disk persistence round trip");
+        restored.loadWithComponents(cover.getUpdateTag(level.registryAccess()),level.registryAccess());
+        helper.assertTrue(restored.sample().is(Blocks.BRICKS), "Chunk synchronization includes selected texture");
+        helper.assertTrue(cover.getUpdatePacket() != null, "Repaint sends block entity update packet");
+        player.setShiftKeyDown(true);
+        tool.useOn(context(player,pos,Direction.EAST));
+        player.setShiftKeyDown(false);
+        tool.useOn(context(player,coverPos,Direction.NORTH));
+        helper.assertTrue(cover.sample().is(Blocks.STONE) && cover.sampleFace() == Direction.EAST, "Existing cover repainted in place");
+        level.destroyBlock(coverPos,true);
+        helper.assertTrue(level.getBlockState(pos).is(Blocks.STONE), "Removing cover restores original face");
+        helper.succeed();
+    }

+        GameType.ADVENTURE.updatePlayerAbilities(adventure.getAbilities());
+        adventure.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND,player.getMainHandItem().copy());

+    @GameTest(template="empty") public static void textureOrientationFollowsPlayerAndSurvivesReload(GameTestHelper helper) {
+        var level = helper.getLevel();
+        var pos = helper.absolutePos(CENTER);
+        level.setBlockAndUpdate(pos, Blocks.FURNACE.defaultBlockState());
+        var player = helper.makeMockPlayer(GameType.SURVIVAL);
+        var tool = PostedSignage.TEXTURE_APPLICATOR.get();
+        player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, new ItemStack(tool));
+        player.setShiftKeyDown(true);
+        tool.useOn(context(player, pos, Direction.NORTH));
+        player.setShiftKeyDown(false);
+        Direction[] sides = {Direction.NORTH, Direction.EAST, Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST};
+        int[] floorRotations = {2, 3, 0, 1};
+        int[] ceilingRotations = {0, 3, 2, 1};
+        for (Direction surface : Direction.values()) {
+            var destination = pos.relative(surface);
+            for (int i = 0; i < sides.length; i++) {
+                Direction side = sides[i];
+                player.setPos(destination.getX() + 0.5 + side.getStepX() * 3,
+                        destination.getY() + 1, destination.getZ() + 0.5 + side.getStepZ() * 3);
+                // Position, not a stale viewing direction, determines the nearest edge.
+                player.setYRot(Direction.NORTH.toYRot());
+                int expected = surface == Direction.UP ? floorRotations[i]
+                        : surface == Direction.DOWN ? ceilingRotations[i] : 0;
+                helper.assertTrue(tool.useOn(context(player, pos, surface)).consumesAction(), "Apply on " + surface);
+                var cover = (TextureCoverBlockEntity) level.getBlockEntity(destination);
+                helper.assertTrue(cover != null && cover.rotation() == expected,
+                        "Rotation on " + surface + " from " + side + " should be " + expected);
+                helper.assertTrue(cover.sample().is(Blocks.FURNACE) && cover.sampleFace() == Direction.NORTH,
+                        "Rotation preserves the selected source face");
+                var restored = new TextureCoverBlockEntity(destination, cover.getBlockState());
+                restored.loadWithComponents(cover.saveWithFullMetadata(level.registryAccess()), level.registryAccess());
+                helper.assertTrue(restored.rotation() == expected, "Rotation survives disk reload");
+                restored.loadWithComponents(cover.getUpdateTag(level.registryAccess()), level.registryAccess());
+                helper.assertTrue(restored.rotation() == expected, "Rotation synchronized to clients");
+                var legacy = cover.getUpdateTag(level.registryAccess());
+                legacy.remove("Rotation");
+                restored.loadWithComponents(legacy, level.registryAccess());
+                helper.assertTrue(restored.rotation() == 0, "Old saves retain the unrotated layout");
+
+                Direction opposite = side.getOpposite();
+                player.setPos(destination.getX() + 0.5 + opposite.getStepX() * 3,
+                        destination.getY() + 1, destination.getZ() + 0.5 + opposite.getStepZ() * 3);
+                // Hitting a thin edge must still use the cover's attached surface.
+                helper.assertTrue(tool.useOn(context(player, destination, Direction.EAST)).consumesAction(), "Repaint succeeds");
+                helper.assertTrue(cover.rotation() == (surface.getAxis() == Direction.Axis.Y ? (expected + 2) % 4 : 0),
+                        "Repaint updates rotation using the existing surface");
+                helper.assertTrue(cover.getUpdatePacket() != null, "Repaint includes a synchronization packet");
+                level.destroyBlock(destination, false);
+            }
+        }
+        for (Direction surface : new Direction[] {Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN}) {
+            var destination = pos.relative(surface);
+            player.setPos(destination.getX() + 0.5, destination.getY() + 2, destination.getZ() + 0.5);
+            for (int i = 0; i < sides.length; i++) {
+                player.setYRot(sides[i].getOpposite().toYRot());
+                helper.assertTrue(TextureApplicatorItem.placementRotation(surface, destination, player)
+                        == (surface == Direction.UP ? floorRotations[i] : ceilingRotations[i]),
+                        "Centered placement uses player heading");
+            }
+        }
+        helper.succeed();
+    }

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
+
+/** One server-side policy shared by door labels and the existing CIT signs. */
+public final class CitAccess {
+    // Evita crear instancias de esta clase de utilidades.
+    private CitAccess() {}
+    // Exige modo Creativo y permisos de operador.
+    public static boolean canEdit(Player player) {
+        return player.isCreative() && player.hasPermissions(2);
+    }
+    // Comprueba también cercanía y acceso a la posición.
+    public static boolean canEditAt(Player player, BlockPos pos) {
+        return canEdit(player) && player.distanceToSqr(pos.getCenter()) <= 64
+                && player.level().mayInteract(player, pos);
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
+import net.minecraft.core.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.*;
+
+/** A stationary frame/controller footprint; separate internal cells hold the open leaf. */
+public final class CitDoorBlock extends BaseEntityBlock {
+    // Orientación, posición de cada pieza y estado de la bisagra.
+    public static final DirectionProperty FACING=BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
+    public static final IntegerProperty X=IntegerProperty.create("part_x",0,1), Y=IntegerProperty.create("part_y",0,2);
+    public static final BooleanProperty RIGHT=BooleanProperty.create("right_hinge"), OPEN=BlockStateProperties.OPEN;
+    public final int width,height;
+    public final boolean hasLabel;
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public CitDoorBlock(Properties p,int w,int h) {
+        this(p,w,h,true);
+    }
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public CitDoorBlock(Properties p,int w,int h,boolean hasLabel) {
+        super(p.dynamicShape());width=w;height=h;this.hasLabel=hasLabel;
+        registerDefaultState(stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING,Direction.NORTH).setValue(X,0).setValue(Y,0).setValue(RIGHT,false).setValue(OPEN,false));
+    }
+    // Permite reconstruir el bloque desde su registro.
+    @Override protected MapCodec<? extends BaseEntityBlock> codec(){return simpleCodec(p->new CitDoorBlock(p,1,2));}
+    // Declara las propiedades guardadas en cada bloque.
+    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block,BlockState> b){b.add(FACING,X,Y,RIGHT,OPEN);}
+    // Crea los datos asociados al bloque colocado.
+    @Override public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(BlockPos p,BlockState s){return new CitDoorEntity(p,s);}
+    // Encuentra el controlador desde cualquier celda del marco.
+    public static BlockPos rootPos(BlockPos p,BlockState s){return p.relative(s.getValue(FACING).getClockWise(),-s.getValue(X)).below(s.getValue(Y));}
+    // Calcula la orientación y comprueba la colocación.
+    @Override public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext c){
+        Direction f=c.getHorizontalDirection().getOpposite(),r=f.getClockWise();
+        BlockPos p=c.getClickedPos();
+        // La mitad pulsada determina el lado de la bisagra.
+        double hit=(c.getClickLocation().x-p.getX()-.5)*r.getStepX()+(c.getClickLocation().z-p.getZ()-.5)*r.getStepZ();
+        for(int x=0;x<width;x++)for(int y=0;y<height;y++){
+            BlockPos q=p.relative(r,x).above(y);
+            if(!c.getLevel().isInWorldBounds(q)||!c.getLevel().getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(q)
+                    ||!c.getLevel().getBlockState(q).canBeReplaced(c)||!c.getLevel().getFluidState(q).isEmpty())return null;
+        }
+        return defaultBlockState().setValue(FACING,f).setValue(RIGHT,hit>=0);
+    }
+    // Monta el marco y recupera la etiqueta del objeto.
+    @Override public void setPlacedBy(Level l,BlockPos p,BlockState s,LivingEntity placer,ItemStack stack){
+        if(l.isClientSide)return;
+        for(int x=0;x<width;x++)for(int y=0;y<height;y++)if(x!=0||y!=0)
+            l.setBlock(p.relative(s.getValue(FACING).getClockWise(),x).above(y),s.setValue(X,x).setValue(Y,y),UPDATE_ALL);
+        if(l.getBlockEntity(p) instanceof CitDoorEntity e){
+            e.readItem(stack);e.sync();
+            if(placer instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)e.openEditor(player);
+        }
+    }
+    // Abre la puerta o solicita editar al agacharse.
+    @Override protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(BlockState s,Level l,BlockPos p,Player player,BlockHitResult hit){
+        if(!l.mayInteract(player,p))return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+        CitDoorEntity e=CitDoorEntity.find(l,p);
+        if(!l.isClientSide&&e!=null){
+            if(hasLabel&&player.isShiftKeyDown()) { if(player instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer sp)e.openEditor(sp); }
+            else e.toggle(player);
+        }
+        return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(l.isClientSide);
+    }
+    // Reutiliza la interacción aunque la mano tenga un objeto.
+    @Override protected ItemInteractionResult useItemOn(ItemStack stack,BlockState s,Level l,BlockPos p,Player player,InteractionHand hand,BlockHitResult hit){
+        useWithoutItem(s,l,p,player,hit);return ItemInteractionResult.sidedSuccess(l.isClientSide);
+    }
+    // Devuelve los límites de selección y colisión.
+    @Override protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState s,BlockGetter l,BlockPos p,CollisionContext c){
+        BlockPos root=rootPos(p,s);
+        VoxelShape shape=CitDoorGeometry.frameShape(root,p,s.getValue(FACING),width,height);
+        return Shapes.or(shape,CitDoorGeometry.leafCells(root,s.getValue(FACING),width,height,s.getValue(RIGHT),s.getValue(OPEN)).getOrDefault(p,Shapes.empty()));
+    }
+    // Retira toda la puerta respetando el modo de juego.
+    @Override public BlockState playerWillDestroy(Level l,BlockPos p,BlockState s,Player player){
+        CitDoorEntity e=CitDoorEntity.find(l,p);if(!l.isClientSide&&e!=null)e.dismantle(!player.isCreative());
+        return super.playerWillDestroy(l,p,s,player);
+    }
+    // Limpia el conjunto si se reemplaza una pieza.
+    @Override protected void onRemove(BlockState s,Level l,BlockPos p,BlockState next,boolean moving){
+        if(!s.is(next.getBlock())&&!l.isClientSide&&l.getBlockEntity(rootPos(p,s)) instanceof CitDoorEntity e)e.dismantle(true);
+        super.onRemove(s,l,p,next,moving);
+    }
+    // Elige cómo se dibuja el bloque.
+    @Override protected RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState s){return RenderShape.ENTITYBLOCK_ANIMATED;}
+}

+// Controla la puerta completa, su etiqueta y sus sesiones de edición.
+public final class CitDoorEntity extends BlockEntity {
+    // Exact dominant colors from the seven existing CIT-sign atlas tiles.
+    public static final int[] COLORS={0x005BD2,0x189C47,0xD9091C,0xF2B801,0x2FAAEE,0x632098,0xFE6101};
+    // Etiqueta persistente; las sesiones de edición son temporales.
+    private String room="525";
+    private int color=3;
+    private UUID editor,token;
+    private long expires;
+    boolean changing,removing;
+    // Inicializa los datos de esta entidad.
+    public CitDoorEntity(BlockPos p,BlockState s){super(PostedSignage.CIT_DOOR_ENTITY.get(),p,s);}
+    // Devuelve el código sin el prefijo CIT-.
+    public String room(){return room;}
+    // Devuelve el índice de la paleta CIT.
+    public int color(){return color;}
+    // Indica si esta variante admite texto.
+    public boolean hasLabel(){return ((CitDoorBlock)getBlockState().getBlock()).hasLabel;}
+    // Restringe la escritura de NBT a operadores.
+    @Override public boolean onlyOpCanSetNbt(){return true;}
+    // Identifica la celda que controla la puerta.
+    public boolean isRoot(){return getBlockState().getValue(CitDoorBlock.X)==0&&getBlockState().getValue(CitDoorBlock.Y)==0;}
+    // Valida dígitos y letra opcional sin perder ceros.
+    public static boolean validRoom(String value){return value!=null&&value.matches("[0-9]{1,4}[A-Z]?");}
+    // Localiza el controlador desde el marco o la hoja.
+    public static CitDoorEntity find(BlockGetter l,BlockPos p){
+        BlockState s=l.getBlockState(p);
+        if(s.getBlock() instanceof CitDoorBlock) {
+            BlockPos root=CitDoorBlock.rootPos(p,s);
+            return l.getBlockEntity(root) instanceof CitDoorEntity e?e:null;
+        }
+        if(l.getBlockEntity(p) instanceof CitSwingEntity e&&e.owner()!=null)
+            return l.getBlockEntity(e.owner()) instanceof CitDoorEntity root?root:null;
+        return null;
+    }
+    // Enumera las celdas del marco fijo.
+    public Set<BlockPos> frameCells(){
+        var b=(CitDoorBlock)getBlockState().getBlock();Set<BlockPos> cells=new LinkedHashSet<>();
+        for(int x=0;x<b.width;x++)for(int y=0;y<b.height;y++)cells.add(worldPosition.relative(getBlockState().getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING).getClockWise(),x).above(y));
+        return cells;
+    }
+    // Divide la hoja en colisiones por celda.
+    public Map<BlockPos,VoxelShape> leafCells(boolean open){
+        var s=getBlockState();var b=(CitDoorBlock)s.getBlock();
+        return CitDoorGeometry.leafCells(worldPosition,s.getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING),b.width,b.height,s.getValue(CitDoorBlock.RIGHT),open);
+    }
+    // Comprueba que la celda móvil pertenece a esta puerta.
+    private boolean ownsProxy(BlockPos p){return level.getBlockEntity(p) instanceof CitSwingEntity e&&worldPosition.equals(e.owner());}
+    // Comprueba que la celda pertenece a este marco.
+    private boolean ownsFrame(BlockPos p){
+        BlockState state=level.getBlockState(p);
+        return state.is(getBlockState().getBlock())&&state.getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING)==getBlockState().getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING)
+                &&worldPosition.equals(CitDoorBlock.rootPos(p,state));
+    }
+    // Valida el espacio antes de mover la puerta completa.
+    public boolean toggle(Player player){
+        if(level==null||level.isClientSide||!isRoot()||player.isSpectator()||player.distanceToSqr(worldPosition.getCenter())>64)return false;
+        boolean open=!getBlockState().getValue(CitDoorBlock.OPEN);
+        var frames=frameCells();var target=leafCells(open);
+        for(BlockPos p:frames)if(!ownsFrame(p)||!level.mayInteract(player,p))return false;
+        // Valida todas las celdas antes de modificar el mundo.
+        for(var entry:target.entrySet()) {
+            BlockPos p=entry.getKey();
+            if(!level.hasChunkAt(p)||!level.isInWorldBounds(p)||!level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(p)||!level.mayInteract(player,p)
+                    ||(!frames.contains(p)&&!ownsProxy(p)&&!level.isEmptyBlock(p))
+                    ||!level.isUnobstructed(null,entry.getValue().move(p.getX(),p.getY(),p.getZ())))return false;
+        }
+        // Evita desmontajes recursivos durante el movimiento.
+        changing=true;
+        try {
+            for(BlockPos p:leafCells(!open).keySet())if(!frames.contains(p)&&!target.containsKey(p)&&ownsProxy(p))level.removeBlock(p,false);
+            for(BlockPos p:frames)level.setBlock(p,level.getBlockState(p).setValue(CitDoorBlock.OPEN,open),Block.UPDATE_ALL);
+            for(BlockPos p:target.keySet())if(!frames.contains(p)){
+                if(!ownsProxy(p))level.setBlock(p,PostedSignage.CIT_DOOR_SWING.get().defaultBlockState(),Block.UPDATE_ALL);
+                if(level.getBlockEntity(p) instanceof CitSwingEntity e)e.setOwner(worldPosition);
+            }
+        } finally {changing=false;}
+        sync();
+        level.playSound(null,worldPosition,open?SoundEvents.IRON_DOOR_OPEN:SoundEvents.IRON_DOOR_CLOSE,SoundSource.BLOCKS,1,1);
+        level.gameEvent(player,open?net.minecraft.world.level.gameevent.GameEvent.BLOCK_OPEN:net.minecraft.world.level.gameevent.GameEvent.BLOCK_CLOSE,worldPosition);
+        return true;
+    }
+    // Retira el conjunto y genera como máximo un objeto.
+    public void dismantle(boolean drop){
+        if(level==null||level.isClientSide||changing||removing||!isRoot())return;
+        removing=true;
+        ItemStack stack=asItem();
+        Set<BlockPos> cells=new LinkedHashSet<>(frameCells());
+        for(BlockPos p:leafCells(true).keySet())if(ownsProxy(p))cells.add(p);
+        // Keep the controller alive until all companion removal callbacks have completed.
+        cells.remove(worldPosition);
+        for(BlockPos p:cells)if(ownsFrame(p)||ownsProxy(p))level.removeBlock(p,false);
+        if(ownsFrame(worldPosition))level.removeBlock(worldPosition,false);
+        if(drop)Block.popResource(level,worldPosition,stack);
+    }
+    // Crea el objeto recuperable con su etiqueta CIT.
+    public ItemStack asItem(){
+        ItemStack stack=new ItemStack(getBlockState().getBlock());
+        if(!hasLabel())return stack;
+        CompoundTag label=new CompoundTag();
+        label.putString("Room",room);label.putInt("Color",color);CompoundTag data=new CompoundTag();data.put("CitDoor",label);
+        stack.set(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA,CustomData.of(data));return stack;
+    }
+    // Recupera la etiqueta almacenada en el objeto.
+    public void readItem(ItemStack stack){
+        if(!hasLabel())return;
+        CompoundTag data=stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA,CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag().getCompound("CitDoor");
+        if(validRoom(data.getString("Room")))room=data.getString("Room");
+        if(data.contains("Color")&&data.getInt("Color")>=0&&data.getInt("Color")<COLORS.length)color=data.getInt("Color");
+    }
+    // Crea una sesión temporal para un editor autorizado.
+    public UUID beginEdit(Player player){
+        if(level==null||level.isClientSide||!hasLabel()||!isRoot()||!CitAccess.canEditAt(player,worldPosition))return null;
+        editor=player.getUUID();token=UUID.randomUUID();expires=level.getGameTime()+1200;return token;
+    }
+    // Envía al jugador los datos de la sesión de edición.
+    public void openEditor(ServerPlayer player){
+        UUID nonce=beginEdit(player);if(nonce!=null)net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player,
+                new CitDoorPayloads.Open(worldPosition,room,color,nonce));
+    }
+    // Revalida sesión, permisos, distancia y etiqueta.
+    public boolean saveEdit(Player player,UUID nonce,String value,int selected){
+        if(level==null||level.isClientSide||!hasLabel()||level.getBlockEntity(worldPosition)!=this||!isRoot()
+                ||!CitAccess.canEditAt(player,worldPosition)||!player.getUUID().equals(editor)||!Objects.equals(token,nonce)
+                ||level.getGameTime()>expires||!validRoom(value)||selected<0||selected>=COLORS.length)return false;
+        room=value;color=selected;editor=null;token=null;sync();return true;
+    }
+    // Marca los cambios y actualiza los clientes.
+    public void sync(){setChanged();if(level!=null)level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition,getBlockState(),getBlockState(),Block.UPDATE_CLIENTS);}
+    // Guarda los datos del bloque en el mundo.
+    @Override protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag,HolderLookup.Provider registry){super.saveAdditional(tag,registry);tag.putString("Room",room);tag.putInt("Color",color);}
+    // Restaura los datos guardados del bloque.
+    @Override protected void loadAdditional(CompoundTag tag,HolderLookup.Provider registry){super.loadAdditional(tag,registry);room=validRoom(tag.getString("Room"))?tag.getString("Room"):"525";color=tag.contains("Color")?Math.floorMod(tag.getInt("Color"),COLORS.length):3;}
+    // Prepara los datos que recibe el cliente.
+    @Override public CompoundTag getUpdateTag(HolderLookup.Provider registry){return saveWithoutMetadata(registry);}
+    // Crea el paquete de sincronización del bloque.
+    @Override public ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket getUpdatePacket(){return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);}
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import java.util.*;
+import net.minecraft.core.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.*;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.*;
+
+/** Geometry in block units. Local north is the front; only the leaf rotates. */
+public final class CitDoorGeometry {
+    // Evita crear instancias de esta clase de utilidades.
+    private CitDoorGeometry() {}
+    // Describe una caja y si su material es vidrio.
+    public record Piece(AABB box, boolean glass) {}
+    // Construye las piezas inmóviles del marco.
+    public static List<Piece> frame(int w, int h) {
+        return List.of(new Piece(new AABB(0,0,.40,.10,h,.60),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(w-.10,0,.40,w,h,.60),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(.10,h-.12,.40,w-.10,h,.60),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(.10,0,.40,w-.10,.04,.60),false));
+    }
+    // Construye el vidrio, los bordes y la manija.
+    public static List<Piece> leaf(int w, int h, boolean right) {
+        double handle = right ? .24 : w-.32;
+        return List.of(new Piece(new AABB(.12,.08,.44,.20,h-.12,.56),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(w-.20,.08,.44,w-.12,h-.12,.56),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(.20,.08,.44,w-.20,.20,.56),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(.20,h-.22,.44,w-.20,h-.12,.56),false),
+                new Piece(new AABB(.20,.20,.48,w-.20,h-.22,.52),true),
+                new Piece(new AABB(handle,h*.43,.33,handle+.08,h*.43+.07,.67),false));
+    }
+    // Gira un punto alrededor de la bisagra elegida.
+    public static Vec3 swing(Vec3 v, int w, boolean right) {
+        double hinge = right ? w-.12 : .12;
+        double sign = right ? -1 : 1;
+        return new Vec3(hinge + sign*(v.z-.5), v.y, .5-sign*(v.x-hinge));
+    }
+    // Convierte coordenadas locales a coordenadas del mundo.
+    public static Vec3 world(Vec3 v, BlockPos root, Direction facing) {
+        Direction right = facing.getClockWise();
+        return root.getCenter().add(right.getStepX()*(v.x-.5)-facing.getStepX()*(v.z-.5),
+                v.y-.5, right.getStepZ()*(v.x-.5)-facing.getStepZ()*(v.z-.5));
+    }
+    // Orienta una caja y aplica el giro de apertura.
+    public static AABB transform(AABB box, BlockPos root, Direction facing, int width, boolean right, boolean open) {
+        Vec3 a = new Vec3(box.minX,box.minY,box.minZ), b = new Vec3(box.maxX,box.maxY,box.maxZ);
+        if (open) { a=swing(a,width,right); b=swing(b,width,right); }
+        a=world(a,root,facing); b=world(b,root,facing);
+        return new AABB(Math.min(a.x,b.x),Math.min(a.y,b.y),Math.min(a.z,b.z),
+                Math.max(a.x,b.x),Math.max(a.y,b.y),Math.max(a.z,b.z));
+    }
+    // Divide la hoja en colisiones por celda.
+    public static Map<BlockPos,VoxelShape> leafCells(BlockPos root, Direction facing, int w, int h, boolean right, boolean open) {
+        Map<BlockPos,VoxelShape> cells=new LinkedHashMap<>();
+        // Full glass collision, even though the material itself is transparent.
+        for (Piece piece: leaf(w,h,right)) {
+            AABB box=transform(piece.box,root,facing,w,right,open);
+            for(int x=(int)Math.floor(box.minX+1e-7);x<Math.ceil(box.maxX-1e-7);x++)
+                for(int y=(int)Math.floor(box.minY+1e-7);y<Math.ceil(box.maxY-1e-7);y++)
+                    for(int z=(int)Math.floor(box.minZ+1e-7);z<Math.ceil(box.maxZ-1e-7);z++) {
+                        BlockPos pos=new BlockPos(x,y,z);
+                        AABB clipped=box.intersect(new AABB(pos)).move(-x,-y,-z);
+                        cells.merge(pos,Shapes.create(clipped),Shapes::or);
+                    }
+        }
+        return cells;
+    }
+    // Recorta el marco a los límites de una celda.
+    public static VoxelShape frameShape(BlockPos root, BlockPos pos, Direction facing, int w, int h) {
+        VoxelShape result=Shapes.empty();
+        for(Piece piece:frame(w,h)) {
+            AABB box=transform(piece.box,root,facing,w,false,false);
+            if(box.intersects(new AABB(pos))) result=Shapes.or(result,Shapes.create(box.intersect(new AABB(pos)).move(-pos.getX(),-pos.getY(),-pos.getZ())));
+        }
+        return result;
+    }
+}

+/** Thin connected glass; arms meet without internal rails, corners retain a post. */
+public final class CitGlassBlock extends BaseEntityBlock {
+    public static final EnumProperty<Direction.Axis> AXIS=BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_AXIS;
+    public static final BooleanProperty N=BlockStateProperties.NORTH,E=BlockStateProperties.EAST,S=BlockStateProperties.SOUTH,W=BlockStateProperties.WEST;
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public CitGlassBlock(Properties p){super(p.dynamicShape());registerDefaultState(stateDefinition.any().setValue(AXIS,Direction.Axis.X).setValue(N,false).setValue(E,false).setValue(S,false).setValue(W,false));}
+    // Permite reconstruir el bloque desde su registro.
+    @Override protected MapCodec<? extends BaseEntityBlock> codec(){return simpleCodec(CitGlassBlock::new);}
+    // Declara las propiedades guardadas en cada bloque.
+    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block,BlockState>b){b.add(AXIS,N,E,S,W);}
+    // Obtiene la propiedad de conexión de una dirección.
+    public static BooleanProperty property(Direction d){return switch(d){case NORTH->N;case EAST->E;case SOUTH->S;default->W;};}
+    // Detecta vidrio o marcos compatibles en el vecino.
+    public static boolean connects(BlockState neighbor,Direction d){
+        if(neighbor.getBlock() instanceof CitGlassBlock)return true;
+        return neighbor.getBlock() instanceof CitDoorBlock&&neighbor.getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING).getAxis()!=d.getAxis();
+    }
+    // Actualiza las cuatro conexiones horizontales.
+    private BlockState connections(BlockState s,LevelAccessor l,BlockPos p){for(Direction d:Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL)s=s.setValue(property(d),connects(l.getBlockState(p.relative(d)),d));return s;}
+    // Actualiza las conexiones al aparecer el panel.
+    @Override protected void onPlace(BlockState s,Level l,BlockPos p,BlockState previous,boolean moving){
+        if(!l.isClientSide&&!previous.is(this))l.setBlock(p,connections(s,l,p),UPDATE_ALL);
+    }
+    // Calcula la orientación y comprueba la colocación.
+    @Override public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext c){return connections(defaultBlockState().setValue(AXIS,c.getHorizontalDirection().getClockWise().getAxis()),c.getLevel(),c.getClickedPos());}
+    // Recalcula el estado al cambiar un vecino.
+    @Override protected BlockState updateShape(BlockState s,Direction d,BlockState n,LevelAccessor l,BlockPos p,BlockPos q){return connections(s,l,p);}
+    // Determina hacia dónde se extiende el panel.
+    public static Set<Direction> arms(BlockState s){
+        Set<Direction> out=EnumSet.noneOf(Direction.class);
+        for(Direction d:Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL)if(s.getValue(property(d)))out.add(d);
+        if(out.isEmpty()){out.add(s.getValue(AXIS)==Direction.Axis.X?Direction.EAST:Direction.NORTH);out.add(out.iterator().next().getOpposite());}
+        else if(out.size()==1)out.add(out.iterator().next().getOpposite());
+        return out;
+    }
+    // Detecta continuidad vertical de vidrio o marco.
+    private static boolean covers(BlockGetter l,BlockPos p,Direction arm){
+        BlockState n=l.getBlockState(p);
+        return n.getBlock() instanceof CitGlassBlock?arms(n).contains(arm):n.getBlock() instanceof CitDoorBlock&&n.getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING).getAxis()!=arm.getAxis();
+    }
+    // Genera vidrio y bordes solo donde corresponden.
+    public static List<CitDoorGeometry.Piece> pieces(BlockState s,BlockGetter l,BlockPos p){
+        List<CitDoorGeometry.Piece> out=new ArrayList<>();Set<Direction> arms=arms(s);
+        for(Direction d:arms){
+            boolean x=d.getAxis()==Direction.Axis.X;
+            double lo=d==Direction.EAST||d==Direction.SOUTH?.5:0,hi=lo+.5;
+            out.add(new CitDoorGeometry.Piece(x?new AABB(lo,0,.48,hi,1,.52):new AABB(.48,0,lo,.52,1,hi),true));
+            if(!covers(l,p.above(),d))out.add(new CitDoorGeometry.Piece(x?new AABB(lo,.90,.40,hi,1,.60):new AABB(.40,.90,lo,.60,1,hi),false));
+            if(!covers(l,p.below(),d))out.add(new CitDoorGeometry.Piece(x?new AABB(lo,0,.40,hi,.10,.60):new AABB(.40,0,lo,.60,.10,hi),false));
+            if(!s.getValue(property(d))) {
+                double a=lo==0?0:.90,b=lo==0?.10:1;
+                out.add(new CitDoorGeometry.Piece(x?new AABB(a,0,.40,b,1,.60):new AABB(.40,0,a,.60,1,b),false));
+            }
+        }
+        // Las esquinas conservan un poste negro común.
+        if(arms.stream().anyMatch(d->d.getAxis()==Direction.Axis.X)&&arms.stream().anyMatch(d->d.getAxis()==Direction.Axis.Z))
+            out.add(new CitDoorGeometry.Piece(new AABB(.40,0,.40,.60,1,.60),false));
+        return out;
+    }
+    // Devuelve los límites de selección y colisión.
+    @Override protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState s,BlockGetter l,BlockPos p,CollisionContext c){VoxelShape shape=Shapes.empty();for(var piece:pieces(s,l,p))shape=Shapes.or(shape,Shapes.create(piece.box()));return shape;}
+    // Crea los datos asociados al bloque colocado.
+    @Override public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(BlockPos p,BlockState s){return new CitGlassEntity(p,s);}
+    // Elige cómo se dibuja el bloque.
+    @Override protected RenderShape getRenderShape(BlockState s){return RenderShape.ENTITYBLOCK_ANIMATED;}

+    @Override

+/** Two-cell wall fountain sharing one block ID. HALF selects geometry; only the lower half yields loot. */
+public final class DrinkingFountainBlock extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock {
+    public static final MapCodec<DrinkingFountainBlock> CODEC = simpleCodec(DrinkingFountainBlock::new);
+    public static final EnumProperty<DoubleBlockHalf> HALF = BlockStateProperties.DOUBLE_BLOCK_HALF;
+    public static final BooleanProperty ACTIVE = BooleanProperty.create("active");
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public DrinkingFountainBlock(Properties properties) {
+        super(properties);
+        registerDefaultState(stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH).setValue(HALF, DoubleBlockHalf.LOWER).setValue(ACTIVE, false));
+    }
+    /** Minecraft uses this codec when reconstructing the block from registry data. */
+    @Override protected MapCodec<? extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock> codec() { return CODEC; }
+    // Declara las propiedades guardadas en cada bloque.
+    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) { builder.add(FACING, HALF, ACTIVE); }
+    // Calcula la orientación y comprueba la colocación.
+    @Override public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
+        Direction facing = context.getClickedFace();
+        BlockPos pos = context.getClickedPos();
+        if (!facing.getAxis().isHorizontal() || pos.getY() >= context.getLevel().getMaxBuildHeight() - 1
+                || !context.getLevel().getBlockState(pos.above()).canBeReplaced(context)
+                || !context.getLevel().getFluidState(pos).isEmpty() || !context.getLevel().getFluidState(pos.above()).isEmpty()) return null;
+        BlockState state = defaultBlockState().setValue(FACING, facing);
+        return supported(state, context.getLevel(), pos) && supported(state, context.getLevel(), pos.above()) ? state : null;
+    }
+    /** FACING points out from the wall; the support therefore lies in the opposite direction. */
+    private boolean supported(BlockState state, LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) {
+        Direction facing = state.getValue(FACING);
+        BlockPos support = pos.relative(facing.getOpposite());
+        return level.getBlockState(support).isFaceSturdy(level, support, facing);
+    }
+    /** Each half independently requires a sturdy attachment face behind its own cell. */
+    @Override protected boolean canSurvive(BlockState state, LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) { return supported(state, level, pos); }
+    // Completa el bebedero colocando su mitad superior.
+    @Override public void setPlacedBy(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, LivingEntity placer, ItemStack stack) {
+        level.setBlock(pos.above(), state.setValue(HALF, DoubleBlockHalf.UPPER), UPDATE_ALL);
+    }
+    /** Removing support or the matching other half collapses the pair through vanilla neighbor updates. */
+    @Override protected BlockState updateShape(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighbor, LevelAccessor level, BlockPos pos, BlockPos neighborPos) {
+        boolean lower = state.getValue(HALF) == DoubleBlockHalf.LOWER;
+        if (!supported(state, level, pos)) return Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
+        if (direction == (lower ? Direction.UP : Direction.DOWN)
+                && (!neighbor.is(this) || neighbor.getValue(HALF) == state.getValue(HALF)
+                || neighbor.getValue(FACING) != state.getValue(FACING))) return Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
+        return state;
+    }
+    /** Remove the lower half without loot when Creative breaks the upper half, avoiding an unintended drop. */
+    @Override public BlockState playerWillDestroy(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, Player player) {
+        if (!level.isClientSide() && player.isCreative() && state.getValue(HALF) == DoubleBlockHalf.UPPER) {
+            if (level.getBlockState(pos.below()).is(this)) level.destroyBlock(pos.below(), false);
+        }
+        return super.playerWillDestroy(level, pos, state, player);
+    }
+    /** Start from north-facing local bounds and rotate every box into the placed orientation. */
+    @Override protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
+        VoxelShape shape = state.getValue(HALF) == DoubleBlockHalf.UPPER
+                ? Block.box(1, 0, 13, 15, 12, 16)
+                : Shapes.or(Block.box(2, 1, 4, 14, 10, 15), Block.box(0, 10, 1, 16, 14, 16),
+                        Block.box(1, 14, 13, 15, 16, 16));
+        int turns = switch (state.getValue(FACING)) { case EAST -> 1; case SOUTH -> 2; case WEST -> 3; default -> 0; };
+        for (int i = 0; i < turns; i++) {
+            VoxelShape[] rotated = {Shapes.empty()};
+            shape.forAllBoxes((x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1) -> rotated[0] = Shapes.or(rotated[0], Shapes.box(1-z1,y0,x0,1-z0,y1,x1)));
+            shape = rotated[0];
+        }
+        return shape;
+    }
+    /** Canonical coordinates face north; the long front push bar is easy to target. */
+    public static boolean isButtonHit(BlockState state, BlockPos pos, BlockHitResult hit) {
+        if (state.getValue(HALF) != DoubleBlockHalf.LOWER || hit.getDirection() != state.getValue(FACING)) return false;
+        Vec3 point = hit.getLocation().subtract(Vec3.atLowerCornerOf(pos));
+        double x = switch (state.getValue(FACING)) { case SOUTH -> 1-point.x; case EAST -> point.z; case WEST -> 1-point.z; default -> point.x; };
+        return x >= 3.0/16 && x <= 13.0/16 && point.y >= 10.0/16 && point.y <= 13.0/16;
+    }
+    /** The client acknowledges a valid click; only the server awards water/food and changes the active state. */
+    private InteractionResult activate(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, BlockHitResult hit) {
+        if (!isButtonHit(state, pos, hit) || player.isSpectator()) return InteractionResult.PASS;
+        if (!level.isClientSide() && Hydration.drink(player)) {
+            level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(ACTIVE, true), UPDATE_ALL);
+            level.scheduleTick(pos, this, 40);
+            level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BUCKET_EMPTY, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 1.3F);
+            level.playSound(null, player.blockPosition(), SoundEvents.GENERIC_DRINK, SoundSource.PLAYERS, 0.65F, 1F);
+        }
+        return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide());
+    }
+    /** Empty-hand clicks share the same button hit test and cooldown as held-item clicks. */
+    @Override protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, BlockHitResult hit) { return activate(state, level, pos, player, hit); }
+    // Activa el bebedero también con un objeto en la mano.
+    @Override protected ItemInteractionResult useItemOn(ItemStack stack, BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, InteractionHand hand, BlockHitResult hit) {
+        return activate(state, level, pos, player, hit).consumesAction() ? ItemInteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide()) : ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
+    }
+    /** A scheduled tick releases the button after the two-second active interval. */
+    @Override protected void tick(BlockState state, ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, RandomSource random) {
+        level.setBlock(pos, state.setValue(ACTIVE, false), UPDATE_ALL);
+    }
+    /** Client particles visualize the active state without placing fluid blocks or changing the world. */
+    @Override public void animateTick(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, RandomSource random) {
+        if (!state.getValue(ACTIVE) || state.getValue(HALF) != DoubleBlockHalf.LOWER) return;
+        for (int i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
+            double t = i / 8.0;
+            // Small arc from the right bubbler toward the drain, staying inside the basin.
+            double x = 3.5/16 + t*0.33, z = 5.0/16 + t*0.12, y = 15.0/16 + 0.28*4*t*(1-t) - 0.16*t;
+            Vec3 p = rotatePoint(state.getValue(FACING), x,y,z).add(Vec3.atLowerCornerOf(pos));
+            level.addParticle(ParticleTypes.FALLING_WATER, p.x,p.y,p.z, 0,0,0);
+        }
+    }
+    /** Use the same quarter-turn transform for particle origins as for collision/model orientation. */
+    private static Vec3 rotatePoint(Direction facing, double x, double y, double z) {
+        return switch(facing) { case EAST -> new Vec3(1-z,y,x); case SOUTH -> new Vec3(1-x,y,1-z); case WEST -> new Vec3(z,y,1-x); default -> new Vec3(x,y,z); };
+    }
+    /** Rotate the stored facing so structure rotations preserve the attachment orientation. */
+    @Override protected BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rotation) { return state.setValue(FACING, rotation.rotate(state.getValue(FACING))); }
+    // Refleja la orientación del bloque.
+    @Override protected BlockState mirror(BlockState state, Mirror mirror) { return rotate(state, mirror.getRotation(state.getValue(FACING))); }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
+import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
+import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.gameevent.GameEvent;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
+
+/** The wide door rotates one complete panel and its occupied footprint together. */
+public final class FacilityDoorBlock extends FacilityMultiBlock {
+    public static final BooleanProperty OPEN = BooleanProperty.create("open");
+    public static final MapCodec<FacilityDoorBlock> CODEC = simpleCodec(p -> new FacilityDoorBlock(p, 1, 2));
+
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public FacilityDoorBlock(Properties properties, int width, int height) {
+        super(properties, width, height);
+        registerDefaultState(defaultBlockState().setValue(OPEN, false));
+    }
+    // Permite reconstruir el bloque desde su registro.
+    @Override protected MapCodec<FacilityDoorBlock> codec() { return CODEC; }
+    /** Legacy world blocks recover as the current text-free door instead of a retired item. */
+    @Override public net.minecraft.world.item.Item asItem() {
+        return width==2?PostedSignage.CLEAR_WIDE_DOOR_ITEM.get():PostedSignage.CLEAR_SHORT_DOOR_ITEM.get();
+    }
+    // Obtiene la dirección horizontal que ocupa el conjunto.
+    @Override protected Direction widthDirection(BlockState state) {
+        return width == 2 && state.getValue(OPEN) ? state.getValue(FACING) : super.widthDirection(state);
+    }
+    // Calcula el origen de la puerta después del giro.
+    BlockPos toggledOrigin(BlockPos anchor, BlockState state) {
+        if (width != 2) return anchor;
+        int sign = state.getValue(OPEN) ? -1 : 1;
+        return anchor.relative(state.getValue(FACING).getClockWise(), sign)
+                .relative(state.getValue(FACING).getOpposite(), sign);
+    }
+    // Declara las propiedades guardadas en cada bloque.
+    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
+        super.createBlockStateDefinition(builder);
+        builder.add(OPEN);
+    }
+    // Comprueba obstáculos y gira todas las piezas antiguas.
+    @Override protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos,
+            Player player, BlockHitResult hit) {
+        if (!player.mayBuild() || !level.mayInteract(player, pos)) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+        if (!level.isClientSide()) {
+            BlockPos anchor = origin(pos, state);
+            Direction right = widthDirection(state);
+            BlockState toggled = state.cycle(OPEN);
+            BlockPos targetOrigin = toggledOrigin(anchor, state);
+            var oldParts = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<BlockPos, BlockState>();
+            var newParts = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<BlockPos, BlockState>();
+            // Check every part before making any change, including protection at other cells.
+            for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+                BlockPos part = anchor.relative(right, x).above(y);
+                if (!level.mayInteract(player, part) || !level.getBlockState(part).equals(
+                        state.setValue(PART_X, x).setValue(PART_Y, y))) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+                oldParts.put(part, level.getBlockState(part));
+                BlockState target = toggled.setValue(PART_X, x).setValue(PART_Y, y);
+                newParts.put(targetOrigin.relative(widthDirection(toggled), x).above(y), target);
+            }
+            for (var entry : newParts.entrySet()) {
+                BlockPos target = entry.getKey();
+                if (!level.hasChunkAt(target) || !level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(target)
+                        || !level.mayInteract(player, target)
+                        || (!oldParts.containsKey(target) && !level.isEmptyBlock(target))
+                        || !level.isUnobstructed(entry.getValue(), target, CollisionContext.empty())) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+            }
+            boolean open = !state.getValue(OPEN);
+            // Install the full target before sending neighbor updates, so no temporary
+            // missing anchor causes a multiblock collapse or loot during the swing.
+            for (BlockPos oldPos : oldParts.keySet()) {
+                if (!newParts.containsKey(oldPos)) level.setBlock(oldPos,
+                        net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), UPDATE_CLIENTS | UPDATE_KNOWN_SHAPE);
+            }
+            for (var entry : newParts.entrySet()) level.setBlock(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue(), UPDATE_CLIENTS | UPDATE_KNOWN_SHAPE);
+            var changed = new java.util.HashSet<>(oldParts.keySet());
+            changed.addAll(newParts.keySet());
+            for (BlockPos changedPos : changed) {
+                level.updateNeighborsAt(changedPos, this);
+                level.getBlockState(changedPos).updateNeighbourShapes(level, changedPos, UPDATE_ALL);
+            }
+            level.playSound(null, anchor, open ? SoundEvents.IRON_DOOR_OPEN : SoundEvents.IRON_DOOR_CLOSE,
+                    SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1, 1);
+            level.gameEvent(player, open ? GameEvent.BLOCK_OPEN : GameEvent.BLOCK_CLOSE, anchor);
+        }
+        return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide());
+    }
+    // Devuelve los límites de selección y colisión.
+    @Override protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
+        double x0 = 0, x1 = 16, z0 = 0, z1 = 3;
+        Direction facing = state.getValue(FACING);
+        if (width == 2) {
+            z0 = 5;
+            z1 = 11;
+            if (state.getValue(OPEN)) facing = facing.getCounterClockWise();
+        } else if (state.getValue(OPEN)) {
+            boolean leftLeaf = width == 2 && state.getValue(PART_X) == 0;
+            x0 = leftLeaf ? 0 : 12;
+            x1 = leftLeaf ? 4 : 16;
+            z1 = 16;
+        }
+        return switch (facing) {
+            case SOUTH -> Block.box(16-x1, 0, 16-z1, 16-x0, 16, 16-z0);
+            case EAST -> Block.box(16-z1, 0, x0, 16-z0, 16, x1);
+            case WEST -> Block.box(z0, 0, 16-x1, z1, 16, 16-x0);
+            default -> Block.box(x0, 0, z0, x1, 16, z1);
+        };
+    }
+}

+    @GameTest(template = "empty")
+    public static void binMenuEmptiesOnlyItsStorageAndReturnsContentsOnBreak(GameTestHelper helper) {
+        var level = helper.getLevel();

+        var block = PostedSignage.TRASH_BIN_BLOCK.get();

+    private static void breakAndCount(GameTestHelper helper, BlockPos selected, BlockPos origin,

+        var drops = level.getEntitiesOfClass(ItemEntity.class, new AABB(origin).inflate(12),
+                entity -> entity.getItem().is(item) && !existingDrops.contains(entity));
+        int count = drops.stream().mapToInt(entity -> entity.getItem().getCount()).sum();
+        helper.assertTrue(count == (mode == GameType.CREATIVE ? 0 : 1),
+                "Exact drop count for " + item + " in " + mode + ": " + count);
+        drops.forEach(ItemEntity::discard);

+    private static void verifyItemPlacement(
+            GameTestHelper helper,
+            ItemStack stack,
+            FacilityMultiBlock block,
+            int width,
+            int height,
+            BlockPos relativeOrigin) {
+        var level = helper.getLevel();
+        BlockPos origin = helper.absolutePos(relativeOrigin);
+        BlockPos floor = origin.below();
+        level.setBlockAndUpdate(floor, Blocks.STONE.defaultBlockState());
+        var player = helper.makeMockPlayer(GameType.CREATIVE);
+        player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, stack);
+        BlockHitResult hit = new BlockHitResult(
+                floor.getCenter().add(0, 0.5, 0), Direction.UP, floor, false);
+        var context = new BlockPlaceContext(player, InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, stack, hit);
+        BlockState preview = block.getStateForPlacement(context);
+        helper.assertTrue(preview != null, "Facility has enough room for placement");
+        helper.assertTrue(preview.canSurvive(level, origin), "Facility origin can enter the world");
+        helper.assertTrue(stack.useOn(context).consumesAction(), "Facility BlockItem accepts placement");
+
+        Direction widthDirection = preview.getValue(FacilityMultiBlock.FACING).getClockWise();
+        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
+            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+                BlockState part = level.getBlockState(origin.relative(widthDirection, x).above(y));
+                helper.assertTrue(part.is(block), "BlockItem creates facility part " + x + "," + y);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Reuse an isolated site for the next item so player-facing direction cannot
+        // make one successfully placed facility obstruct another test case.
+        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
+            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+                level.setBlock(origin.relative(widthDirection, x).above(y), Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(),
+                        FacilityMultiBlock.UPDATE_ALL);
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    // Comprueba montaje, soporte y retirada del conjunto.
+    private static void verifyLifecycle(
+            GameTestHelper helper,
+            FacilityMultiBlock block,
+            int width,
+            int height,
+            BlockPos relativeOrigin) {
+        var level = helper.getLevel();
+        BlockPos origin = helper.absolutePos(relativeOrigin);
+        BlockState state = block.defaultBlockState().setValue(FacilityMultiBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH);
+        level.setBlockAndUpdate(origin, state);
+        block.setPlacedBy(level, origin, state, null, ItemStack.EMPTY);
+
+        Direction widthDirection = Direction.NORTH.getClockWise();
+        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
+            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+                BlockPos partPos = origin.relative(widthDirection, x).above(y);
+                BlockState part = level.getBlockState(partPos);
+                helper.assertTrue(part.is(block), "Facility part exists at " + x + "," + y);
+                helper.assertTrue(part.getValue(FacilityMultiBlock.PART_X) == x, "Facility part_x is correct");
+                helper.assertTrue(part.getValue(FacilityMultiBlock.PART_Y) == y, "Facility part_y is correct");
+                helper.assertTrue(part.getValue(FacilityMultiBlock.FACING) == Direction.NORTH, "Facility facing is preserved");
+            }
+        }
+
+        var player = helper.makeMockPlayer(GameType.SURVIVAL);
+        BlockPos removedPart = origin.relative(widthDirection, width - 1).above(height - 1);
+        BlockState removedState = level.getBlockState(removedPart);
+        block.playerWillDestroy(level, removedPart, removedState, player);
+        level.setBlock(removedPart, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), FacilityMultiBlock.UPDATE_ALL);
+        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
+            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+                BlockPos partPos = origin.relative(widthDirection, x).above(y);
+                helper.assertTrue(level.getBlockState(partPos).is(Blocks.AIR), "Breaking one part removes the whole facility");
+            }
+        }
+    }

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk;
+import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
+import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
+import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.level.ChunkEvent;
+
+/** Remove only obsolete upper cells after legacy IDs have resolved through registry aliases. */
+@EventBusSubscriber(modid = PostedSignage.MOD_ID)
+public final class FacilityMigration {
+    // Evita crear instancias de esta clase de utilidades.
+    private FacilityMigration() {}
+    // Elimina únicamente las piezas antiguas obsoletas.
+    public static void removeObsoleteCell(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos) {
+        var state = level.getBlockState(pos);
+        if (state.getBlock() instanceof FacilityMultiBlock block && block.isObsoletePart(state)) {
+            // Old decorative upper cells had no inventory or independent item ownership.
+            level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), Block.UPDATE_ALL | Block.UPDATE_SUPPRESS_DROPS);
+        }
+    }
+    // Programa la limpieza de piezas antiguas al cargar.
+    @SubscribeEvent
+    public static void onChunkLoad(ChunkEvent.Load event) {
+        if (!(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !(event.getChunk() instanceof LevelChunk chunk)) return;
+        // Queue after loading finishes, even when ChunkEvent runs on the server thread.
+        level.getServer().tell(new net.minecraft.server.TickTask(level.getServer().getTickCount() + 1, () -> {
+            if (!level.hasChunk(chunk.getPos().x, chunk.getPos().z)) return;
+            var sections = chunk.getSections();
+            for (int index = 0; index < sections.length; index++) {
+                var section = sections[index];
+                if (!section.maybeHas(state -> state.getBlock() instanceof FacilityMultiBlock block && block.isObsoletePart(state))) continue;
+                int baseY = chunk.getMinBuildHeight() + index * 16;
+                for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
+                    var state = section.getBlockState(x, y, z);
+                    if (state.getBlock() instanceof FacilityMultiBlock block && block.isObsoletePart(state)) {
+                        removeObsoleteCell(level, new BlockPos(chunk.getPos().getMinBlockX() + x, baseY + y, chunk.getPos().getMinBlockZ() + z));
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }));
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
+import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelReader;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.HorizontalDirectionalBlock;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Mirror;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.IntegerProperty;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
+
+/** A thin decorative object whose item places a complete width-by-height structure. */
+public class FacilityMultiBlock extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock {
+    public static final MapCodec<FacilityMultiBlock> CODEC = simpleCodec(p -> new FacilityMultiBlock(p, 1, 1));
+    public static final IntegerProperty PART_X = IntegerProperty.create("part_x", 0, 1);
+    public static final IntegerProperty PART_Y = IntegerProperty.create("part_y", 0, 2);
+    protected final int width;
+    protected final int height;
+
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public FacilityMultiBlock(Properties properties, int width, int height) {
+        super(properties);
+        this.width = width;
+        this.height = height;
+        registerDefaultState(stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH).setValue(PART_X, 0).setValue(PART_Y, 0));
+    }
+    // Permite reconstruir el bloque desde su registro.
+    @Override protected MapCodec<? extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock> codec() { return CODEC; }
+    // Declara las propiedades guardadas en cada bloque.
+    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) { builder.add(FACING, PART_X, PART_Y); }
+
+    // Calcula la orientación y comprueba la colocación.
+    @Override public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
+        Direction facing = context.getHorizontalDirection().getOpposite();
+        BlockPos origin = context.getClickedPos();
+        if (origin.getY() + height > context.getLevel().getMaxBuildHeight()) return null;
+        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+            BlockPos p = origin.relative(facing.getClockWise(), x).above(y);
+            if (!context.getLevel().getBlockState(p).canBeReplaced(context) || !context.getLevel().getFluidState(p).isEmpty()) return null;
+        }
+        return defaultBlockState().setValue(FACING, facing);
+    }
+
+    // Coloca las piezas restantes del conjunto.
+    @Override public void setPlacedBy(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, LivingEntity placer, ItemStack stack) {
+        Direction facing = state.getValue(FACING);
+        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+            if (x == 0 && y == 0) continue;
+            level.setBlock(pos.relative(widthDirection(state), x).above(y), state.setValue(PART_X, x).setValue(PART_Y, y), UPDATE_ALL);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Localiza el origen a partir de cualquier pieza.
+    protected BlockPos origin(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
+        return pos.relative(widthDirection(state), -state.getValue(PART_X)).below(state.getValue(PART_Y));
+    }
+    // Obtiene la dirección horizontal que ocupa el conjunto.
+    protected Direction widthDirection(BlockState state) { return state.getValue(FACING).getClockWise(); }
+    // Comprueba que el bloque conserva su soporte.
+    @Override protected boolean canSurvive(BlockState state, LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) {
+        if (isObsoletePart(state)) return false;
+        // The origin must be allowed to enter the world before it can anchor the
+        // remaining parts. Requiring it to find itself here makes BlockItem reject
+        // every initial placement before setPlacedBy has a chance to assemble it.
+        if (state.getValue(PART_X) == 0 && state.getValue(PART_Y) == 0) return true;
+        BlockPos o = origin(pos, state);
+        return level.getBlockState(o).is(this) && level.getBlockState(o).getValue(FACING) == state.getValue(FACING);
+    }
+    // Detecta piezas fuera de las dimensiones actuales.
+    public boolean isObsoletePart(BlockState state) {
+        return state.getValue(PART_X) >= width || state.getValue(PART_Y) >= height;
+    }
+    // Recalcula el estado al cambiar un vecino.
+    @Override protected BlockState updateShape(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighbor, LevelAccessor level, BlockPos pos, BlockPos neighborPos) {
+        return canSurvive(state, level, pos) ? state : Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
+    }
+    // Retira las piezas compañeras sin duplicar el objeto.
+    @Override public BlockState playerWillDestroy(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, Player player) {
+        if (!level.isClientSide()) {
+            BlockPos o = origin(pos, state);
+            Direction f = state.getValue(FACING);
+            var parts = new LinkedHashMap<BlockPos, BlockState>();
+            for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
+                BlockPos p = o.relative(widthDirection(state), x).above(y);
+                BlockState expected = state.setValue(PART_X, x).setValue(PART_Y, y);
+                if (level.getBlockState(p).equals(expected)) parts.put(p, expected);
+            }
+            MultiblockRemoval.beforePlayerBreak(level, pos, o, parts, player);
+        }
+        return super.playerWillDestroy(level, pos, state, player);
+    }
+    // Gira la orientación guardada.
+    @Override public BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rotation) { return state.setValue(FACING, rotation.rotate(state.getValue(FACING))); }
+    // Refleja la orientación del bloque.
+    @Override public BlockState mirror(BlockState state, Mirror mirror) { return rotate(state, mirror.getRotation(state.getValue(FACING))); }
+    // Devuelve los límites de selección y colisión.
+    @Override protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) { return Block.box(0, 0, 2, 16, 16, 14); }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelReader;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
+
+/** Mount the back of a sign on the actual pane face, 0.48 blocks inside its cell. */
+public final class GlassSignMount {
+    public static final BooleanProperty GLASS_MOUNTED=BooleanProperty.create("glass_mounted");
+    public static final double INSET=.48;
+    // Evita crear instancias de esta clase de utilidades.
+    private GlassSignMount(){}
+    // Acepta caras amplias sin brazos que atraviesen el letrero.
+    public static boolean glassFace(BlockState support,Direction facing){
+        if(!(support.getBlock() instanceof CitGlassBlock))return false;
+        var arms=CitGlassBlock.arms(support);
+        // Require a complete broad face; a projecting corner arm would intersect the sign.
+        return arms.contains(facing.getClockWise())&&arms.contains(facing.getCounterClockWise())&&!arms.contains(facing);
+    }
+    // Comprueba soporte en vidrio compatible o pared sólida.
+    public static boolean supported(LevelReader level,BlockPos pos,Direction facing){
+        var backing=pos.relative(facing.getOpposite());var state=level.getBlockState(backing);
+        return glassFace(state,facing)||state.isFaceSturdy(level,backing,facing);
+    }
+    // Actualiza si el letrero está montado sobre vidrio.
+    public static BlockState state(BlockState state,LevelReader level,BlockPos pos,Direction facing){
+        return state.setValue(GLASS_MOUNTED,glassFace(level.getBlockState(pos.relative(facing.getOpposite())),facing));
+    }
+    // Calcula el desplazamiento hacia la cara real del vidrio.
+    public static Vec3 offset(BlockState state,Direction facing){
+        return state.getValue(GLASS_MOUNTED)?new Vec3(-facing.getStepX()*INSET,0,-facing.getStepZ()*INSET):Vec3.ZERO;
+    }
+    // Desplaza la selección junto con el letrero.
+    public static VoxelShape shape(VoxelShape shape,BlockState state,Direction facing){
+        var delta=offset(state,facing);return shape.move(delta.x,delta.y,delta.z);
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
+import javax.annotation.Nullable;
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelReader;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.HorizontalDirectionalBlock;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Mirror;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
+
+/**
+ * A double-sided projecting sign attached to a vertical wall by its short edge.
+ * FACING points away from the supporting wall and controls the projection axis.
+ */
+public final class HangingSignBlock extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock {
+    public static final MapCodec<HangingSignBlock> CODEC = simpleCodec(HangingSignBlock::new);
+
+    // Overall bounds include the panel, raised frame, wall plate, and supports.
+    private static final VoxelShape NORTH_SHAPE = Block.box(6.25, 2.5, 5.25, 9.75, 13.5, 16.0);
+    private static final VoxelShape SOUTH_SHAPE = Block.box(6.25, 2.5, 0.0, 9.75, 13.5, 10.75);
+    private static final VoxelShape WEST_SHAPE = Block.box(5.25, 2.5, 6.25, 16.0, 13.5, 9.75);
+    private static final VoxelShape EAST_SHAPE = Block.box(0.0, 2.5, 6.25, 10.75, 13.5, 9.75);
+
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public HangingSignBlock(Properties properties) {
+        super(properties);
+        registerDefaultState(stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH).setValue(GlassSignMount.GLASS_MOUNTED, false));
+    }
+
+    /** Minecraft uses this codec when reconstructing the block from registry data. */
+    @Override
+    protected MapCodec<? extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock> codec() {
+        return CODEC;
+    }
+
+    // Calcula la orientación y comprueba la colocación.
+    @Nullable
+    @Override
+    public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
+        BlockState state = defaultBlockState();
+        LevelReader level = context.getLevel();
+        BlockPos pos = context.getClickedPos();
+
+        // Match vanilla wall-mounted blocks: try the player's nearest horizontal
+        // directions and select the first orientation with a sturdy wall behind it.
+        for (Direction direction : context.getNearestLookingDirections()) {
+            if (direction.getAxis().isHorizontal()) {
+                state = state.setValue(FACING, direction.getOpposite());
+                if (state.canSurvive(level, pos)) {
+                    return GlassSignMount.state(state,level,pos,state.getValue(FACING));
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        return null;
+    }
+
+    /** Check the sturdy wall face behind the outward-facing block. */
+    @Override
+    protected boolean canSurvive(BlockState state, LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) {
+        Direction facing = state.getValue(FACING);
+        BlockPos supportPos = pos.relative(facing.getOpposite());
+        return GlassSignMount.supported(level,pos,facing);
+    }
+
+    /** Recheck support after neighbor changes and remove the block when its attachment is lost. */
+    @Override
+    protected BlockState updateShape(
+            BlockState state,
+            Direction direction,
+            BlockState neighborState,
+            LevelAccessor level,
+            BlockPos pos,
+            BlockPos neighborPos) {
+        if (direction == state.getValue(FACING).getOpposite() && !state.canSurvive(level, pos)) {
+            return Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
+        }
+        return GlassSignMount.state(super.updateShape(state, direction, neighborState, level, pos, neighborPos),level,pos,state.getValue(FACING));
+    }
+
+    /** Return bounds matching the placed orientation for outline selection and default collision handling. */
+    @Override
+    protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
+        VoxelShape shape = switch (state.getValue(FACING)) {
+            case SOUTH -> SOUTH_SHAPE;
+            case WEST -> WEST_SHAPE;
+            case EAST -> EAST_SHAPE;
+            default -> NORTH_SHAPE;
+        };
+        return GlassSignMount.shape(shape,state,state.getValue(FACING));
+    }
+
+    /** Rotate the stored facing so structure rotations preserve the attachment orientation. */
+    @Override
+    protected BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rotation) {
+        return state.setValue(FACING, rotation.rotate(state.getValue(FACING)));
+    }
+
+    /** Convert mirroring into the appropriate facing rotation. */
+    @Override
+    protected BlockState mirror(BlockState state, Mirror mirror) {
+        return rotate(state, mirror.getRotation(state.getValue(FACING)));
+    }
+
+    /** Declare the properties Minecraft serializes and uses to select blockstate model variants. */
+    @Override
+    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
+        builder.add(FACING, GlassSignMount.GLASS_MOUNTED);
+    }

+            () -> new DehydrationEffect(0x9ba59a).addAttributeModifier(Attributes.ATTACK_DAMAGE,
+                    ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PostedSignage.MOD_ID, "thirst_weakness"), -4,
+                    AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_VALUE));
+    public static final DeferredHolder<MobEffect, MobEffect> SLOWNESS = EFFECTS.register("dehydration_slowness",
+            () -> new DehydrationEffect(0x7699a6).addAttributeModifier(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED,
+                    ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PostedSignage.MOD_ID, "thirst_slowness"), -0.15,
+                    AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL));
+
+    private static final class DehydrationEffect extends MobEffect {
+        DehydrationEffect(int color) { super(MobEffectCategory.HARMFUL, color); }
+    }
+    // Evita crear instancias de esta clase de utilidades.
+    private Hydration() {}
+
+    /** Lazily initialize namespaced persistent NBT; absent data means a new player starts fully hydrated. */
+    public static CompoundTag data(Player player) {
+        CompoundTag persistent = player.getPersistentData();
+        if (!persistent.contains(KEY)) {
+            CompoundTag initial = new CompoundTag();
+            initial.putInt("level", MAX);
+            persistent.put(KEY, initial);
+        }
+        return persistent.getCompound(KEY);
+    }
+    /** Clamp values loaded from saves or packets to the HUD's supported 0..20 range. */
+    public static int level(Player player) { return Math.clamp(data(player).getInt("level"), 0, MAX); }
+    /** Share the same range guard between server updates and client hydration snapshots. */
+    public static void setLevel(Player player, int value) { data(player).putInt("level", Math.clamp(value, 0, MAX)); }
+    /** Creative and Spectator are exempt from draining and dehydration penalties. */
+    public static boolean eligible(Player player) { return !player.isCreative() && !player.isSpectator(); }
+
+    /** Advance cooldown independently of thirst; only living Survival/Adventure players accumulate drain ticks. */
+    public static void advance(Player player) {
+        CompoundTag tag = data(player);
+        tag.putInt("cooldown", Math.max(0, tag.getInt("cooldown") - 1));
+        if (eligible(player) && player.isAlive()) {
+            int elapsed = tag.getInt("elapsed") + 1;
+            if (elapsed >= DRAIN_TICKS) {
+                elapsed = 0;
+                setLevel(player, level(player) - 1);
+                sync(player);
+            }
+            tag.putInt("elapsed", elapsed);
+        }
+        updateEffects(player);
+    }
+
+    /** Apply all benefits once per player cooldown; this method is called by server-side interaction handling. */
+    public static boolean drink(Player player) {
+        if (player.isSpectator() || !player.isAlive() || data(player).getInt("cooldown") > 0) return false;
+        data(player).putInt("cooldown", COOLDOWN_TICKS);
+        setLevel(player, level(player) + DRINK_AMOUNT);
+        player.getFoodData().eat(2, 0.5F); // Two hunger points and two saturation points, capped by vanilla.
+        player.clearFire();
+        updateEffects(player);
+        sync(player);
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    /** Refresh only this mod's dehydration effects and remove them immediately when the player recovers. */
+    private static void updateEffects(Player player) {
+        if (eligible(player) && level(player) == 0 && player.isAlive()) {
+            if (!player.hasEffect(WEAKNESS) || player.getEffect(WEAKNESS).getDuration() < 20)
+                player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(WEAKNESS, 60, 0, true, false, true));
+            if (!player.hasEffect(SLOWNESS) || player.getEffect(SLOWNESS).getDuration() < 20)
+                player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(SLOWNESS, 60, 0, true, false, true));
+        } else {
+            player.removeEffect(WEAKNESS);
+            player.removeEffect(SLOWNESS);
+        }
+    }
+    /** Send the authoritative value only to its owning player; mock players without a connection need no packet. */
+    public static void sync(Player player) {
+        if (player instanceof ServerPlayer serverPlayer && serverPlayer.connection != null)
+            PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(serverPlayer, new HydrationPayload(level(player)));
+    }
+    /** Copy only this mod's compound into the replacement player, preserving death/respawn hydration progress. */
+    public static void copy(Player oldPlayer, Player newPlayer) {
+        newPlayer.getPersistentData().put(KEY, data(oldPlayer).copy());
+    }
+    /** The tick event fires on both sides; only the logical server may advance persistent hydration. */
+    @SubscribeEvent public static void tick(PlayerTickEvent.Post event) {
+        if (!event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) advance(event.getEntity());
+    }
+    /** Minecraft creates a new player entity on respawn, so transfer the namespaced state explicitly. */
+    @SubscribeEvent public static void clonePlayer(PlayerEvent.Clone event) { copy(event.getOriginal(), event.getEntity()); }
+    // Sincroniza la hidratación al entrar al servidor.
+    @SubscribeEvent public static void login(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent event) { sync(event.getEntity()); }
+    // Sincroniza la hidratación después de reaparecer.
+    @SubscribeEvent public static void respawn(PlayerEvent.PlayerRespawnEvent event) { sync(event.getEntity()); }
+    // Sincroniza la hidratación al cambiar de dimensión.
+    @SubscribeEvent public static void dimension(PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent event) { sync(event.getEntity()); }
+}
