+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf;
+import net.minecraft.network.codec.StreamCodec;
+import net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload;
+import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
+import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.event.RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent;
+
+/** Server-to-client snapshot of the local player's hydration; clients do not submit hydration values. */
+public record HydrationPayload(int value) implements CustomPacketPayload {
+    public static final Type<HydrationPayload> TYPE = new Type<>(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PostedSignage.MOD_ID, "hydration"));
+    public static final StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, HydrationPayload> CODEC = StreamCodec.of(
+            (buf, payload) -> buf.writeVarInt(payload.value), buf -> new HydrationPayload(buf.readVarInt()));
+    /** Return the registered packet identifier used to route this payload. */
+    @Override public Type<HydrationPayload> type() { return TYPE; }
+    // Conecta los registros y manejadores correspondientes.
+    public static void register(RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent event) {
+        // Uses only common Player APIs, so no client classes are linked on dedicated servers.
+        event.registrar("1").playToClient(TYPE, CODEC, (payload, context) ->
+                context.enqueueWork(() -> Hydration.setLevel(context.player(), payload.value)));
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import java.util.Map;
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+
+/** Remove companion cells without recursive shape updates evaluating their loot. */
+final class MultiblockRemoval {
+    // Evita crear instancias de esta clase de utilidades.
+    private MultiblockRemoval() {}
+
+    // Retira las piezas compañeras sin duplicar objetos.
+    static void beforePlayerBreak(Level level, BlockPos selected, BlockPos origin,
+            Map<BlockPos, BlockState> parts, Player player) {
+        if (level.isClientSide()) return;
+        // Vanilla handles the selected cell's loot. Only the origin has a loot entry,
+        // so transfer its drop when the player instead selected a companion cell.
+        BlockState originState = parts.get(origin);
+        if (!player.isCreative() && !selected.equals(origin) && originState != null
+                && originState.canHarvestBlock(level, origin, player)) {
+            Block.dropResources(originState, level, origin, level.getBlockEntity(origin),
+                    player, player.getMainHandItem());
+        }
+        for (BlockPos pos : parts.keySet()) {
+            if (!pos.equals(selected)) {
+                level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), Block.UPDATE_CLIENTS | Block.UPDATE_KNOWN_SHAPE);
+            }
+        }
+        for (var part : parts.entrySet()) {
+            if (!part.getKey().equals(selected)) {
+                level.updateNeighborsAt(part.getKey(), part.getValue().getBlock());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import java.util.List;
+import net.minecraft.core.*;
+import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
+import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;

+import net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.context.UseOnContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.RenderShape;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+
+// Copia una cara de textura y la aplica a otra superficie.
+public final class TextureApplicatorItem extends Item {
+    // Conecta los registros y eventos del mod.
+    public TextureApplicatorItem(Properties properties) { super(properties); }
+    // Da prioridad al aplicador frente al bloque pulsado.
+    @Override public InteractionResult onItemUseFirst(ItemStack stack, UseOnContext context) {
+        return useOn(context); // Sample/apply before chests, furnaces and other block interactions.
+    }
+    // Muestrea o aplica la textura según la interacción.
+    @Override public InteractionResult useOn(UseOnContext context) {
+        var player = context.getPlayer();
+        var level = context.getLevel();
+        var pos = context.getClickedPos();
+        if (player == null || !player.mayBuild() || !level.mayInteract(player, pos)) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+        BlockState clicked = level.getBlockState(pos);
+        var stack = context.getItemInHand();
+        if (player.isShiftKeyDown()) {
+            BlockState sample = clicked;
+            Direction face = context.getClickedFace();
+            if (level.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof TextureCoverBlockEntity cover) {
+                sample = cover.sample();
+                face = cover.sampleFace();
+            }
+            if (sample.getRenderShape() != RenderShape.MODEL) return message(context, "invalid_sample");
+            if (!level.isClientSide) {
+                CompoundTag data = stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag();
+                data.put("Sample", NbtUtils.writeBlockState(sample));
+                data.putString("SampleFace", face.getName());
+                stack.set(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.of(data));
+                player.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("message.posted_signage.sampled", sample.getBlock().getName()), true);
+            }
+            return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide);
+        }
+        CompoundTag data = stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag();
+        if (!data.contains("Sample")) return message(context, "select_first");
+        BlockState sample = NbtUtils.readBlockState(level.holderLookup(Registries.BLOCK), data.getCompound("Sample"));
+        if (sample.isAir() || sample.getRenderShape() != RenderShape.MODEL) return message(context, "invalid_sample");
+        Direction sourceFace = Direction.byName(data.getString("SampleFace"));
+        Direction face = context.getClickedFace();
+        boolean repaint = clicked.is(PostedSignage.TEXTURE_COVER_BLOCK.get());
+        BlockPos destination = repaint ? pos : pos.relative(face);
+        if (!level.mayInteract(player, destination) || !player.mayUseItemAt(destination, face, stack)) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+        if (!repaint) {
+            if (!clicked.isFaceSturdy(level, pos, face) || !level.isEmptyBlock(destination) || level.isOutsideBuildHeight(destination)) return message(context, "no_space");
+        }
+        if (!level.isClientSide) {
+            if (!repaint) level.setBlockAndUpdate(destination, PostedSignage.TEXTURE_COVER_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState().setValue(TextureCoverBlock.FACING, face));
+            if (level.getBlockEntity(destination) instanceof TextureCoverBlockEntity cover) {
+                Direction surface = cover.getBlockState().getValue(TextureCoverBlock.FACING);
+                cover.setSample(sample, sourceFace == null ? Direction.NORTH : sourceFace,
+                        placementRotation(surface, destination, player));
+            }
+        }
+        return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide);
+    }
+    /** Horizontal surfaces read upright from the player's side; vertical faces stay upright. */
+    static int placementRotation(Direction surface, BlockPos destination, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player) {
+        if (surface.getAxis() != Direction.Axis.Y) return 0;
+        double dx = player.getX() - (destination.getX() + 0.5);
+        double dz = player.getZ() - (destination.getZ() + 0.5);
+        Direction top;
+        if (dx * dx + dz * dz < 0.0001) {
+            top = player.getDirection();
+        } else {
+            Direction towardPlayer = Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dz)
+                    ? (dx > 0 ? Direction.EAST : Direction.WEST)
+                    : (dz > 0 ? Direction.SOUTH : Direction.NORTH);
+            top = towardPlayer.getOpposite();
+        }
+        // The renderer's unrotated top edge points north on floors and south on ceilings.
+        return switch (top) {
+            case EAST -> 1;
+            case WEST -> 3;
+            case NORTH -> surface == Direction.UP ? 0 : 2;
+            case SOUTH -> surface == Direction.UP ? 2 : 0;
+            default -> 0;
+        };
+    }
+    // Muestra al jugador el resultado de la aplicación.
+    private InteractionResult message(UseOnContext context, String key) {
+        if (!context.getLevel().isClientSide) context.getPlayer().displayClientMessage(Component.translatable("message.posted_signage." + key), true);
+        return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+    }
+    // Muestra la selección de textura en la descripción.
+    @Override public void appendHoverText(ItemStack stack, TooltipContext context, List<Component> tooltip, TooltipFlag flag) {
+        tooltip.add(Component.translatable("tooltip.posted_signage.texture_applicator"));
+        CompoundTag data = stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag();
+        if (data.contains("Sample")) tooltip.add(Component.translatable("tooltip.posted_signage.sample", data.getCompound("Sample").getString("Name"), data.getString("SampleFace")));
+    }
+}

+            case WEST -> box(15.98, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16);
+            case EAST -> box(0, 0, 0, 0.02, 16, 16);
+            case UP -> box(0, 0, 0, 16, 0.02, 16);

+    @Override protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) { builder.add(FACING); }

+package com.postedsignage;

+import net.minecraft.core.*;
+import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;

+/** Stores a sampled state and face, with vanilla chunk/update packet synchronization. */
+public final class TextureCoverBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {
+    private BlockState sample = Blocks.BRICKS.defaultBlockState();
+    private Direction sampleFace = Direction.NORTH;
+    private int rotation;
+    // Inicializa los datos de esta entidad.
+    public TextureCoverBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) { super(PostedSignage.TEXTURE_COVER_ENTITY.get(), pos, state); }

+    public Direction sampleFace() { return sampleFace; }
+    // Devuelve el giro guardado en cuartos de vuelta.
+    public int rotation() { return rotation; }
+    // Guarda la textura elegida y sincroniza el cambio.
+    public void setSample(BlockState state, Direction face) {
+        setSample(state, face, 0);
+    }
+    // Guarda la textura elegida y sincroniza el cambio.
+    public void setSample(BlockState state, Direction face, int quarterTurns) {
+        sample = state;
+        sampleFace = face;
+        rotation = Math.floorMod(quarterTurns, 4);
+        setChanged();
+        if (level != null) level.sendBlockUpdated(worldPosition, getBlockState(), getBlockState(), Block.UPDATE_CLIENTS);
+    }
+    // Guarda los datos del bloque en el mundo.
+    @Override protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
+        super.saveAdditional(tag, registries);
+        tag.put("Sample", NbtUtils.writeBlockState(sample));
+        tag.putString("SampleFace", sampleFace.getName());
+        tag.putInt("Rotation", rotation);
+    }
+    // Restaura los datos guardados del bloque.
+    @Override protected void loadAdditional(CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
+        super.loadAdditional(tag, registries);
+        sample = NbtUtils.readBlockState(registries.lookupOrThrow(Registries.BLOCK), tag.getCompound("Sample"));
+        Direction face = Direction.byName(tag.getString("SampleFace"));
+        sampleFace = face == null ? Direction.NORTH : face;
+        // Older covers did not store rotation and retain their original UV layout.
+        rotation = Math.floorMod(tag.getInt("Rotation"), 4);
+    }
+    // Prepara los datos que recibe el cliente.
+    @Override public CompoundTag getUpdateTag(HolderLookup.Provider registries) { return saveWithoutMetadata(registries); }
+    // Crea el paquete de sincronización del bloque.
+    @Override public ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket getUpdatePacket() { return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this); }

+        if (!player.mayBuild() || !level.mayInteract(player, pos)) return ItemInteractionResult.FAIL;
+        if (!level.isClientSide() && level.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof TrashBinBlockEntity bin) {
+            if (!bin.canAccess(player)) return ItemInteractionResult.FAIL;
+            int inserted = bin.storeHeldItems(player, hand);
+            if (inserted == 0) player.displayClientMessage(
+                    net.minecraft.network.chat.Component.translatable("message.posted_signage.bin_full"), true);
+        }
+        // Consume even when full so held blocks, buckets and food are not used accidentally.
+        return ItemInteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide());
+    }
+    // Abre el inventario al usar la mano vacía.
+    @Override protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player, BlockHitResult hit) {
+        if (!player.mayBuild() || !level.mayInteract(player, pos)) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+        if (!level.isClientSide() && level.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof TrashBinBlockEntity bin) {
+            if (!bin.canAccess(player)) return InteractionResult.FAIL;
+            player.openMenu(bin);
+        }
+        return InteractionResult.sidedSuccess(level.isClientSide());
+    }

+    @Override protected void onRemove(BlockState state, Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState replacement, boolean moving) {

+            level.updateNeighbourForOutputSignal(pos, this);
+        }
+        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, replacement, moving);
+    }
+    // Devuelve los límites de selección y colisión.
+    @Override protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
+        return Block.box(1, 0, 1, 15, 16, 15);
+    }

+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BaseContainerBlockEntity;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+
+/** Nine persistent slots; held stacks are stored and the menu provides explicit disposal. */
+public final class TrashBinBlockEntity extends BaseContainerBlockEntity {
+    private NonNullList<ItemStack> items = NonNullList.withSize(9, ItemStack.EMPTY);
+
+    // Inicializa los datos de esta entidad.
+    public TrashBinBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) { super(PostedSignage.TRASH_BIN_ENTITY.get(), pos, state); }
+    // Define las nueve ranuras del basurero.
+    @Override public int getContainerSize() { return 9; }
+    // Devuelve el contenido del inventario.
+    @Override protected NonNullList<ItemStack> getItems() { return items; }
+    // Reemplaza el contenido del inventario.
+    @Override protected void setItems(NonNullList<ItemStack> items) { this.items = items; }
+    // Obtiene el nombre traducido del basurero.
+    @Override protected Component getDefaultName() { return Component.translatable("block.posted_signage.trash_bin"); }
+    // Conecta el inventario con su menú.
+    @Override protected AbstractContainerMenu createMenu(int id, Inventory inventory) {
+        return new TrashBinMenu(id, inventory, this);
+    }
+    // Extrae una ranura y marca el cambio para guardarlo.
+    @Override public ItemStack removeItemNoUpdate(int slot) {
+        ItemStack removed = super.removeItemNoUpdate(slot);
+        if (!removed.isEmpty()) setChanged();
+        return removed;
+    }
+    // Vacía el inventario y marca los datos modificados.
+    @Override public void clearContent() { super.clearContent(); setChanged(); }
+    // Comprueba permisos, cercanía y acceso al contenedor.
+    public boolean canAccess(Player player) {
+        return level != null && !level.isClientSide() && player.mayBuild() && stillValid(player)
+                && level.mayInteract(player, worldPosition) && canOpen(player);
+    }
+    // Guarda lo que cabe y deja el sobrante en la mano.
+    public int storeHeldItems(Player player, InteractionHand hand) {
+        if (!canAccess(player)) return 0;
+        ItemStack held = player.getItemInHand(hand);
+        int before = held.getCount();
+        // Fill compatible stacks first, then vacant slots. Never consume overflow.
+        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2 && !held.isEmpty(); pass++) {
+            for (int slot = 0; slot < getContainerSize() && !held.isEmpty(); slot++) {
+                ItemStack stored = getItem(slot);
+                if (pass == 0 && !stored.isEmpty() && ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents(stored, held)) {
+                    int moved = Math.min(held.getCount(), Math.max(0,
+                            Math.min(getMaxStackSize(), stored.getMaxStackSize()) - stored.getCount()));
+                    stored.grow(moved);
+                    held.shrink(moved);
+                } else if (pass == 1 && stored.isEmpty()) {
+                    int moved = Math.min(held.getCount(), Math.min(getMaxStackSize(), held.getMaxStackSize()));
+                    setItem(slot, held.split(moved));
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        int inserted = before - held.getCount();
+        if (inserted > 0) {
+            setChanged();
+            player.getInventory().setChanged();
+            player.containerMenu.broadcastChanges();
+        }
+        return inserted;
+    }
+    // Guarda los datos del bloque en el mundo.
+    @Override protected void saveAdditional(CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
+        super.saveAdditional(tag, registries);
+        ContainerHelper.saveAllItems(tag, items, registries);
+    }
+    // Restaura los datos guardados del bloque.
+    @Override protected void loadAdditional(CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
+        super.loadAdditional(tag, registries);
+        items = NonNullList.withSize(9, ItemStack.EMPTY);
+        ContainerHelper.loadAllItems(tag, items, registries);
+    }
+}

+            addSlot(new Slot(inventory, col + row * 9 + 9, 8 + col * 18, 88 + row * 18));
+        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) addSlot(new Slot(inventory, i, 8 + i * 18, 146));
+    }

+        return bin instanceof TrashBinBlockEntity entity ? entity.canAccess(player) : bin.stillValid(player);

+    @Override public boolean clickMenuButton(Player player, int id) {
+        if (id != 0 || player.containerMenu != this || !(bin instanceof TrashBinBlockEntity entity)
+                || !entity.canAccess(player) || bin.isEmpty()) return false;
+        bin.clearContent();
+        bin.setChanged();
+        broadcastChanges();
+        return true;
+    }
+    // Transfiere objetos con Mayús entre ambos inventarios.
+    @Override public ItemStack quickMoveStack(Player player, int index) {
+        if (index < 0 || index >= slots.size() || !stillValid(player)) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
+        Slot slot = slots.get(index);
+        if (!slot.hasItem()) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
+        ItemStack current = slot.getItem();
+        ItemStack original = current.copy();
+        if (!(index < 9 ? moveItemStackTo(current, 9, 45, true) : moveItemStackTo(current, 0, 9, false)))
+            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
+        if (current.isEmpty()) slot.setByPlayer(ItemStack.EMPTY); else slot.setChanged();
+        slot.onTake(player, current);
+        return original;
+    }
+    // Notifica al contenedor que el jugador cerró el menú.
+    @Override public void removed(Player player) {
+        super.removed(player);
+        bin.stopOpen(player);
+    }

+package com.postedsignage;
+
+import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
+import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelReader;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.HorizontalDirectionalBlock;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Mirror;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
+import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
+
+/** Thin wall sign whose outward FACING determines both its supporting wall and selection bounds. */
+public final class WallSignBlock extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock {
+    public static final MapCodec<WallSignBlock> CODEC = simpleCodec(WallSignBlock::new);
+
+    // FACING points away from the supporting wall. The panel therefore sits on
+    // the opposite edge of its block space, directly against that support.
+    private static final VoxelShape NORTH_SHAPE = Block.box(3.0, 3.0, 15.5, 13.0, 13.0, 16.0);
+    private static final VoxelShape SOUTH_SHAPE = Block.box(3.0, 3.0, 0.0, 13.0, 13.0, 0.5);
+    private static final VoxelShape WEST_SHAPE = Block.box(15.5, 3.0, 3.0, 16.0, 13.0, 13.0);
+    private static final VoxelShape EAST_SHAPE = Block.box(0.0, 3.0, 3.0, 0.5, 13.0, 13.0);
+
+    // Configura las propiedades iniciales del bloque.
+    public WallSignBlock(Properties properties) {
+        super(properties);
+        registerDefaultState(stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH).setValue(GlassSignMount.GLASS_MOUNTED, false));
+    }
+
+    /** Minecraft uses this codec when reconstructing the block from registry data. */
+    @Override
+    protected MapCodec<? extends HorizontalDirectionalBlock> codec() {
+        return CODEC;
+    }
+
+    // Calcula la orientación y comprueba la colocación.
+    @Override
+    public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
+        Direction clickedFace = context.getClickedFace();
+        if (!clickedFace.getAxis().isHorizontal()) {
+            return null;
+        }
+
+        BlockState state = defaultBlockState().setValue(FACING, clickedFace);
+        return state.canSurvive(context.getLevel(), context.getClickedPos())
+                ? GlassSignMount.state(state,context.getLevel(),context.getClickedPos(),clickedFace) : null;
+    }
+
+    /** Check the sturdy wall face behind the outward-facing block. */
+    @Override
+    protected boolean canSurvive(BlockState state, LevelReader level, BlockPos pos) {
+        Direction facing = state.getValue(FACING);
+        BlockPos supportPos = pos.relative(facing.getOpposite());
+        return GlassSignMount.supported(level,pos,facing);
+    }
+
+    /** Recheck support after neighbor changes and remove the block when its attachment is lost. */
+    @Override
+    protected BlockState updateShape(
+            BlockState state,
+            Direction direction,
+            BlockState neighborState,
+            LevelAccessor level,
+            BlockPos pos,
+            BlockPos neighborPos) {
+        if (direction == state.getValue(FACING).getOpposite() && !state.canSurvive(level, pos)) {
+            return Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
+        }
+        return GlassSignMount.state(super.updateShape(state, direction, neighborState, level, pos, neighborPos),level,pos,state.getValue(FACING));
+    }
+
+    /** Return bounds matching the placed orientation for outline selection and default collision handling. */
+    @Override
+    protected VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter level, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
+        VoxelShape shape = switch (state.getValue(FACING)) {
+            case SOUTH -> SOUTH_SHAPE;
+            case WEST -> WEST_SHAPE;
+            case EAST -> EAST_SHAPE;
+            default -> NORTH_SHAPE;
+        };
+        return GlassSignMount.shape(shape,state,state.getValue(FACING));
+    }
+
+    /** Rotate the stored facing so structure rotations preserve the attachment orientation. */
+    @Override
+    protected BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rotation) {
+        return state.setValue(FACING, rotation.rotate(state.getValue(FACING)));
+    }
+
+    /** Convert mirroring into the appropriate facing rotation. */
+    @Override
+    protected BlockState mirror(BlockState state, Mirror mirror) {
+        return rotate(state, mirror.getRotation(state.getValue(FACING)));
+    }
+
+    /** Declare the properties Minecraft serializes and uses to select blockstate model variants. */
+    @Override
+    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
+        builder.add(FACING, GlassSignMount.GLASS_MOUNTED);
+    }
+}

+// Dibuja marco, hoja y etiqueta de la puerta CIT.
+public final class CitDoorRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<CitDoorEntity> {
+    private final Font font;
+    // Crea el renderizador del cliente.
+    public CitDoorRenderer(BlockEntityRendererProvider.Context c){font=c.getFont();}
+    // Dibuja el marco fijo y la hoja con su etiqueta giratoria.
+    @Override public void render(CitDoorEntity e,float tick,PoseStack pose,MultiBufferSource buffers,int light,int overlay){
+        if(!e.isRoot())return;
+        var s=e.getBlockState();var b=(CitDoorBlock)s.getBlock();boolean right=s.getValue(CitDoorBlock.RIGHT);
+        pose.pushPose();pose.translate(.5,0,.5);pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(180-s.getValue(CitDoorBlock.FACING).toYRot()));pose.translate(-.5,0,-.5);
+        // Dibuja el marco antes de aplicar el giro de la hoja.
+        for(var p:CitDoorGeometry.frame(b.width,b.height))CitGeometryRenderer.piece(p,pose,buffers,light);
+        if(s.getValue(CitDoorBlock.OPEN)){
+            double hinge=right?b.width-.12:.12;
+            pose.translate(hinge,0,.5);pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(right?-90:90));pose.translate(-hinge,0,-.5);
+        }
+        for(var p:CitDoorGeometry.leaf(b.width,b.height,right))CitGeometryRenderer.piece(p,pose,buffers,light);
+        if(!e.hasLabel()){pose.popPose();return;}
+        String text="CIT-"+e.room();
+        // Ajusta el texto para que quepa en la altura disponible.
+        float scale=Math.min(.042F,(b.height-.6F)/font.width(text));
+        double centerX=right?b.width-.44:.44;
+        for(boolean back:new boolean[]{false,true}){
+            pose.pushPose();pose.translate(centerX,b.height/2.0,back?.524:.476);
+            // Same physical hinge edge, readable bottom-to-top from either side.
+            if(!back)pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(180));
+            pose.mulPose(Axis.ZP.rotationDegrees(90));pose.scale(scale,-scale,scale);
+            font.drawInBatch(text,-font.width(text)/2F,-font.lineHeight/2F,0xFF000000|CitDoorEntity.COLORS[e.color()],false,
+                    pose.last().pose(),buffers,Font.DisplayMode.NORMAL,0,light);
+            pose.popPose();
+        }
+        pose.popPose();
+    }
+    // Permite dibujar piezas fuera de la celda principal.
+    @Override public boolean shouldRenderOffScreen(CitDoorEntity e){return true;}
+    // Fija la distancia máxima de renderizado.
+    @Override public int getViewDistance(){return 96;}
+}

+package com.postedsignage.client;
+
+import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.*;
+import com.postedsignage.CitDoorGeometry;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.*;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture;
+import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
+
+/** Shared opaque frame / lightly tinted glass rendering, without glass edge textures. */
+final class CitGeometryRenderer {
+    private static final ResourceLocation WHITE=ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("posted_signage","textures/block/cit_glass_panel_white.png");
+    // Dibuja una pieza opaca o transparente sin costuras.
+    static void piece(CitDoorGeometry.Piece piece,PoseStack pose,MultiBufferSource buffers,int light){
+        var b=piece.box();
+        double[][] v={{b.minX,b.minY,b.minZ},{b.maxX,b.minY,b.minZ},{b.maxX,b.maxY,b.minZ},{b.minX,b.maxY,b.minZ},
+                {b.minX,b.minY,b.maxZ},{b.maxX,b.minY,b.maxZ},{b.maxX,b.maxY,b.maxZ},{b.minX,b.maxY,b.maxZ}};
+        int[][] faces={{0,3,2,1},{5,6,7,4},{1,2,6,5},{4,7,3,0},{3,7,6,2},{4,0,1,5}};
+        float[][] normals={{0,0,-1},{0,0,1},{1,0,0},{-1,0,0},{0,1,0},{0,-1,0}};
+        VertexConsumer consumer=buffers.getBuffer(piece.glass()?RenderType.entityTranslucent(WHITE):RenderType.entitySolid(WHITE));
+        int rgb=piece.glass()?0xC7E1E9:0x23272C,alpha=piece.glass()?38:255;
+        for(int f=0;f<6;f++){
+            // No thin end faces on transparent panels, so neighboring pieces leave no seams.
+            if(piece.glass()&&(b.getXsize()<b.getZsize()?f!=2&&f!=3:f!=0&&f!=1))continue;
+            for(int i=0;i<4;i++) {var p=v[faces[f][i]];
+                consumer.addVertex(pose.last(),(float)p[0],(float)p[1],(float)p[2])
+                        .setColor((rgb>>16)&255,(rgb>>8)&255,rgb&255,alpha)
+                        .setUv(i<2?0:1,i==0||i==3?1:0).setOverlay(OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(light)
+                        .setNormal(pose.last(),normals[f][0],normals[f][1],normals[f][2]);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage.client;
+
+import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack;
+import com.mojang.math.Axis;
+import com.postedsignage.CustomizableHangingSignBlock;
+import com.postedsignage.CustomizableHangingSignBlockEntity;
+import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
+import net.minecraft.client.gui.Font;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRendererProvider;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
+import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.SignText;
+
+/** Draws only the user-editable lettering over the fixed textured sign face. */
+public final class CustomizableHangingSignRenderer
+        implements BlockEntityRenderer<CustomizableHangingSignBlockEntity> {
+    private static final int TEXT_COLOR = 0xFF252525;
+    private static final float TEXT_SCALE = 0.0062F;
+
+    private final Font font;
+
+    // Crea el renderizador del cliente.
+    public CustomizableHangingSignRenderer(BlockEntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
+        this.font = context.getFont();
+    }
+
+    /** Rotate into the block's local frame, then render front and back text separately. */
+    @Override
+    public void render(CustomizableHangingSignBlockEntity sign, float partialTick, PoseStack poseStack,
+            MultiBufferSource buffers, int packedLight, int packedOverlay) {
+        Direction facing = sign.getBlockState().getValue(CustomizableHangingSignBlock.FACING);
+        float rotation = switch (facing) {
+            case EAST -> -90.0F;
+            case SOUTH -> -180.0F;
+            case WEST -> -270.0F;
+            default -> 0.0F;
+        };
+
+        poseStack.pushPose();
+        var mount=com.postedsignage.GlassSignMount.offset(sign.getBlockState(),facing);
+        poseStack.translate(0.5+mount.x, 0.5, 0.5+mount.z);
+        poseStack.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(rotation));
+
+        renderFace(sign.getFrontText(), false, poseStack, buffers, packedLight);
+        renderFace(sign.getBackText(), true, poseStack, buffers, packedLight);
+
+        poseStack.popPose();
+    }
+
+    /** Offset lettering from the panel, orient it outward and honor Minecraft's text-filter preference. */
+    private void renderFace(SignText text, boolean back, PoseStack poseStack,
+            MultiBufferSource buffers, int packedLight) {
+        poseStack.pushPose();
+        poseStack.translate(back ? -0.055 : 0.055, 0.0, 0.008);
+        poseStack.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(back ? -90.0F : 90.0F));
+        poseStack.scale(TEXT_SCALE, -TEXT_SCALE, TEXT_SCALE);
+
+        boolean filtered = Minecraft.getInstance().isTextFilteringEnabled();
+        Component[] lines = text.getMessages(filtered);
+        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+            Component line = lines[i];
+            float x = -font.width(line) / 2.0F;

+                    Font.DisplayMode.POLYGON_OFFSET, 0, packedLight);
+        }
+        poseStack.popPose();
+    }

+package com.postedsignage.client;
+
+import com.postedsignage.Hydration;
+import com.postedsignage.PostedSignage;
+import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
+import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
+import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
+import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
+import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
+import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterGuiLayersEvent;
+import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.gui.VanillaGuiLayers;
+
+/** Client-only ten-drop hydration overlay, positioned after vanilla reserves space for food and air. */
+@EventBusSubscriber(modid = PostedSignage.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
+public final class HydrationHud {
+    /** Reserve one additional HUD row after air/food to avoid overlapping vanilla status bars. */
+    @SubscribeEvent public static void register(RegisterGuiLayersEvent event) {
+        event.registerAbove(VanillaGuiLayers.AIR_LEVEL, ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PostedSignage.MOD_ID, "hydration"), (gui, delta) -> {
+            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
+            if (mc.options.hideGui || mc.player == null || !Hydration.eligible(mc.player)) return;
+            int right = gui.guiWidth() / 2 + 91;
+            // NeoForge reserves rightHeight for food, air and vehicle health before this layer.
+            int y = gui.guiHeight() - mc.gui.rightHeight;
+            mc.gui.rightHeight += 10;
+            int value = Hydration.level(mc.player);
+            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
+                int x = right - 9 - i * 8;
+                // Cada gota representa dos puntos de hidratación.
+                int fill = Math.clamp(value - (9 - i) * 2, 0, 2);
+                String sprite = fill == 2 ? "full" : fill == 1 ? "half" : "empty";
+                gui.blitSprite(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(PostedSignage.MOD_ID, "hydration/" + sprite), x, y, 9, 9);
+            }
+        });
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage.client;
+
+import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack;
+import com.postedsignage.TextureCoverBlock;
+import com.postedsignage.TextureCoverBlockEntity;
+import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.*;
+import net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.*;
+import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
+import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
+
+/** Uses the sampled face's atlas sprite, including animated/resource-pack textures. */
+public final class TextureCoverRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<TextureCoverBlockEntity> {
+    // Crea el renderizador del cliente.
+    public TextureCoverRenderer(BlockEntityRendererProvider.Context context) {}
+    // Dibuja la cara copiada con su orientación e iluminación.
+    @Override public void render(TextureCoverBlockEntity cover, float partialTick, PoseStack pose, MultiBufferSource buffers, int light, int overlay) {
+        var minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();
+        var state = cover.sample();
+        var model = minecraft.getBlockRenderer().getBlockModel(state);
+        var quads = model.getQuads(state, cover.sampleFace(), RandomSource.create(42), net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.data.ModelData.EMPTY, null);
+        if (quads.isEmpty()) quads = model.getQuads(state, null, RandomSource.create(42), net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.data.ModelData.EMPTY, null).stream().filter(q -> q.getDirection() == cover.sampleFace()).toList();
+        var sprite = quads.isEmpty() ? model.getParticleIcon(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.model.data.ModelData.EMPTY) : quads.getFirst().getSprite();
+        int tint = !quads.isEmpty() && quads.getFirst().isTinted()
+                ? minecraft.getBlockColors().getColor(state, cover.getLevel(), cover.getBlockPos(), quads.getFirst().getTintIndex()) : 0xFFFFFF;
+        Direction face = cover.getBlockState().getValue(TextureCoverBlock.FACING);
+        float e = 0.00125F;
+        float[][] vertices = switch (face) {
+            case NORTH -> new float[][]{{1,0,1-e},{0,0,1-e},{0,1,1-e},{1,1,1-e}};
+            case SOUTH -> new float[][]{{0,0,e},{1,0,e},{1,1,e},{0,1,e}};
+            case WEST -> new float[][]{{1-e,0,0},{1-e,0,1},{1-e,1,1},{1-e,1,0}};
+            case EAST -> new float[][]{{e,0,1},{e,0,0},{e,1,0},{e,1,1}};
+            case UP -> new float[][]{{0,e,1},{1,e,1},{1,e,0},{0,e,0}};
+            case DOWN -> new float[][]{{0,1-e,0},{1,1-e,0},{1,1-e,1},{0,1-e,1}};
+        };
+        // Use the block shader: the entity shader applies a second directional-light
+        // multiplier on top of getShade(), making covers unnaturally dark. The block
+        // shader applies the supplied world lightmap without that extra shading.
+        var consumer = buffers.getBuffer(RenderType.cutout());
+        float shade = cover.getLevel() == null ? 1 : cover.getLevel().getShade(face, true);
+        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
+            int uv = (i + cover.rotation()) % 4;
+            consumer.addVertex(pose.last(), vertices[i][0], vertices[i][1], vertices[i][2])
+                    .setColor((int)(((tint >> 16) & 255) * shade), (int)(((tint >> 8) & 255) * shade), (int)((tint & 255) * shade), 255)
+                    .setUv(uv == 0 || uv == 3 ? sprite.getU0() : sprite.getU1(), uv < 2 ? sprite.getV1() : sprite.getV0())
+                    .setLight(light)
+                    .setNormal(pose.last(), face.getStepX(), face.getStepY(), face.getStepZ());
+        }
+    }
+}

+package com.postedsignage.client;
+
+import com.postedsignage.TrashBinMenu;
+import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
+import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
+import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Tooltip;
+import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen;
+import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
+import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory;
+
+// Muestra el inventario y el botón de vaciado.
+public final class TrashBinScreen extends AbstractContainerScreen<TrashBinMenu> {
+    private Button emptyButton;
+    // Inicializa la pantalla con sus datos de apertura.
+    public TrashBinScreen(TrashBinMenu menu, Inventory inventory, Component title) {
+        super(menu, inventory, title);
+        imageHeight = 170;
+        inventoryLabelY = 76;
+    }
+    // Crea y coloca los controles de la pantalla.
+    @Override protected void init() {
+        super.init();
+        titleLabelX = (imageWidth - font.width(title)) / 2;
+        emptyButton = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(
+                Component.translatable("screen.posted_signage.bin_empty"), button -> {
+                    if (minecraft != null && minecraft.gameMode != null)
+                        minecraft.gameMode.handleInventoryButtonClick(menu.containerId, 0);
+                }).bounds(leftPos + 8, topPos + 44, 160, 20)
+                .tooltip(Tooltip.create(Component.translatable("screen.posted_signage.bin_empty_tooltip"))).build());
+        updateButton();
+    }
+    // Habilita el vaciado solo si hay objetos guardados.
+    private void updateButton() {
+        emptyButton.active = menu.slots.subList(0, 9).stream().anyMatch(slot -> slot.hasItem());
+    }
+    // Actualiza los controles mientras el menú está abierto.
+    @Override protected void containerTick() { super.containerTick(); updateButton(); }
+    // Dibuja el fondo y las ranuras del inventario.
+    @Override protected void renderBg(GuiGraphics graphics, float tick, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
+        graphics.fill(leftPos, topPos, leftPos + imageWidth, topPos + imageHeight, 0xFF373C3A);
+        graphics.fill(leftPos + 2, topPos + 2, leftPos + imageWidth - 2, topPos + imageHeight - 2, 0xFFD7DDD9);
+        for (var slot : menu.slots) {
+            int x = leftPos + slot.x, y = topPos + slot.y;
+            graphics.fill(x - 1, y - 1, x + 17, y + 17, 0xFF606863);
+            graphics.fill(x, y, x + 16, y + 16, 0xFFAFB8B2);
+        }
+    }
+    // Dibuja el contenido usando el estado actual.
+    @Override public void render(GuiGraphics graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY, float tick) {
+        super.render(graphics, mouseX, mouseY, tick);
+        renderTooltip(graphics, mouseX, mouseY);
+    }
+}
